entries.english: Welcome to the world of Mu.;We have been waiting for a hero like you to arrive and put a stop to the chaos brought on to the Mu realm by Kundun.
entries.zh-CN: 欢迎来到奇迹世界。;我们一直等待像你这样的勇士，终结昆顿给奇迹大陆带来的混乱。

entries.english: Continue listening.
entries.zh-CN: 继续听下去。

entries.english: However, journeys such as this are bound to be perilous.;If you wish, we can provide you with a simple tutorial. What do you say?
entries.zh-CN: 然而，这样的旅程必定充满危险。;如果你愿意，我们可以提供简单的新手教学。你意下如何？

entries.english: A tutorial?;I look forward to it!
entries.zh-CN: 新手教学？;我很期待！

entries.english: Tutorials are for children. Turn down the offer.
entries.zh-CN: 新手教学是给孩子的。拒绝帮助。

entries.english: It won't take up too much of your time. I'll simply explain basic controls and hunting techniques.;Are you sure you don't want our help?
entries.zh-CN: 不会占用你太多时间。我只会简单介绍基本操作和打怪技巧。;你确定不需要我们的帮助吗？

entries.english: I have plenty of experience.;To each his own!
entries.zh-CN: 我已经很有经验了。;每个人都有自己的选择！

entries.english: How can I turn him down...?;Alright, let's give it a try!
entries.zh-CN: 怎能拒绝他的好意呢……;好吧，试试看！

entries.english: I'm glad we can help. We aren't difficult to find.;Simply look for and talk to the Shadow Phantom Soldier in any of the towns.
entries.zh-CN: 很高兴能够帮到你。我们并不难找。;在各个城镇找到幻影导师，与他交谈即可。

entries.english: I regret we can't be of any help to you.;Here, at least take this present. I hope, the next time we meet, a great warrior stands before my eyes.;Enjoy your time out there.
entries.zh-CN: 很遗憾没能帮到你。;至少请收下这份礼物。希望下次见面时，你已成为一名出色的勇士。;祝你旅途愉快。

entries.english: I respect your decision to go on this journey.;Allow me to teach you a few simple but essential things you need to know before your adventure in MU begins.
entries.zh-CN: 我尊重你踏上旅程的决定。;在奇迹冒险开始前，让我教你一些简单却必不可少的知识。

entries.english: ...This is Noria, the kingdom of Elves! So this is where my adventure begins.;How exhilarating!
entries.zh-CN: ……这里是弓箭手的王国仙踪林！我的冒险就从这里开始。;真令人兴奋！

entries.english: ...This is Lorencia, the kingdom of Dark Wizards and Dark Knights! So this is where my adventure begins.;Excellent! My adventure begins!
entries.zh-CN: ……这里是魔法师与剑士的王国勇者大陆！我的冒险就从这里开始。;太好了！冒险开始了！

entries.english: ...This is Elveland, the kingdom of Summoners! So this is where my adventure begins.;How exhilarating!
entries.zh-CN: ……这里是召唤术师的王国幻术园！我的冒险就从这里开始。;真令人兴奋！

entries.english: It's nice to meet you.;May I ask who you are?
entries.zh-CN: 很高兴认识你。;请问你是谁？

entries.english: Alright! Let's get started with the tutorial.
entries.zh-CN: 好！让我们开始新手教学吧。

entries.english: Let's start with something simple.;Close your quest window and either press C or click on the Character (C) button located on the bottom right of your screen to launch the Character Stats window.
entries.zh-CN: 先从简单的操作开始。;关闭任务窗口，按 C 键或点击屏幕右下方的角色（C）按钮，打开角色属性窗口。

entries.english: Now, press the I button or click on the Inventory (I/V) button located on the bottom right to open your Inventory window.
entries.zh-CN: 现在按 I 键，或点击屏幕右下方的背包（I/V）按钮，打开背包窗口。

entries.english: Press Q, W, E to use the items such as healing potion, mana potion, antidote, alcohol or town portal scroll registered under those keys.
entries.zh-CN: 按 Q、W、E 键，可使用绑定在对应快捷键上的治疗药水、魔法药水、解毒剂、酒或回城卷轴。

entries.english: Vault usage fee is deducted from your inventory according to your level.
entries.zh-CN: 使用仓库的费用根据角色等级从背包中扣除。

entries.english: Use the lock function on your vault to protect it.
entries.zh-CN: 使用仓库上锁功能保护你的物品。

entries.english: Point the cursor on the skill button and press ctrl+number key to set hotkey.
entries.zh-CN: 将鼠标移到技能按钮上，按 Ctrl＋数字键设置快捷键。

entries.english: Press space bar to collect loot.
entries.zh-CN: 按空格键拾取物品。

entries.english: To combat normally, left click on monster.
entries.zh-CN: 鼠标左键点击怪物进行普通攻击。

entries.english: To use skill during combat, right click on monster.
entries.zh-CN: 鼠标右键点击怪物施放技能。

entries.english: Right click on scrolls or orbs to master the noted skills.
entries.zh-CN: 鼠标右键点击技能卷轴或技能石，即可学习对应技能。

entries.english: To use skills or magic, right click on monster.
entries.zh-CN: 鼠标右键点击怪物，使用技能或魔法。

entries.english: The command (trade, party, whisper, etc.) system is accessible by pressing the 'D' key.
entries.zh-CN: 按 D 键打开指令菜单，可使用交易、组队、密语等功能。

entries.english: Click shortcut key T to check the quest information.
entries.zh-CN: 按 T 键查看任务信息。

entries.english: Wearing a level +5 or above boots allows you to run.
entries.zh-CN: 穿戴强化等级为 +5 或以上的靴子即可奔跑。

entries.english: When poisoned, you can cure yourself by using the antidote.
entries.zh-CN: 中毒后可使用解毒剂解除中毒。

entries.english: Using the 'town portal scroll' will transport you to the nearest town or safe area.
entries.zh-CN: 使用回城卷轴可返回最近的城镇或安全区。

entries.english: To save a screenshot in your Mu folder, press the 'Print Screen' key.
entries.zh-CN: 按 Print Screen 键截图，图片将保存在奇迹客户端目录中。

entries.english: Item's performance level decreases when the durability decreases.
entries.zh-CN: 物品耐久度降低时，其性能也会下降。

entries.english: To use the saved chatting macro, press Alt+number.
entries.zh-CN: 按 Alt＋数字键使用已保存的聊天宏。

entries.english: To fix your weapon or armor, go to the weapon merchants in town.
entries.zh-CN: 前往城镇的武器商人处修理武器或防具。

entries.english: The supplementary magic of the Elf can be used by clicking the name in the party window.
entries.zh-CN: 点击组队窗口中的角色名称，可对其施放弓箭手的辅助魔法。

entries.english: Click shortcut key T to check the quest information.
entries.zh-CN: 按 T 键查看任务信息。

entries.english: I'm sure you are well aware of Kundun. The weakest and most disorganized monsters of Kundun's army are frequently attacking and plundering civilians just outside of town. I wanted to ask you to eliminate these plundering monsters.... Will you accept this quest? (Level 15-25)
entries.zh-CN: 你一定听说过昆顿吧。昆顿军中最弱小、最散乱的怪物经常在城外袭击和抢掠平民。我想请你消灭这些劫掠者……你愿意接受这个任务吗？（等级15-25）

entries.english: Dispose of the Town Plunderers!
entries.zh-CN: 消灭城外的劫掠者！

entries.english: Oh, I haven't introduced myself yet. My name is Olga. My fellow comrades from the Shadow Phantom Guardians and I serve Erin Gustiv, the queen of Noria.
entries.zh-CN: 啊，还没自我介绍。我叫 Olga。我和幻影守护者的同伴们共同效忠于仙踪林女王 Erin Gustiv。

entries.english: ...Shadow Phantom?;Guardians of the queen?
entries.zh-CN: ……幻影守护者？;女王的卫士？

entries.english: What are the queen's guardians doing at a place like this?
entries.zh-CN: 女王的卫士为什么会在这里？

entries.english: The queen's orders are to help those warriors starting out on their journey so that they can at least defend themselves against the forces of Kundun.
entries.zh-CN: 女王命我们帮助初出茅庐的勇士，让他们至少能够抵御昆顿的势力，保护自己。

entries.english: ...I'm moved that the queen has made such orders.
entries.zh-CN: ……女王竟有这样的命令，真令人感动。

entries.english: How will you help, exactly?
entries.zh-CN: 你们具体会怎样帮助我？

entries.english: I will teach you basic hunting and controls through a simple tutorial.;It's not that difficult, and I'm sure you'll finish it in no time.
entries.zh-CN: 我会通过简单的新手教学，教你基本操作和打怪技巧。;并不难，相信你很快就能学会。

entries.english: Great! I'll finish this tutorial in no time!
entries.zh-CN: 太好了！我一定很快就能完成教学！

entries.english: Excellent! Let's get started with the tutorial.
entries.zh-CN: 很好！让我们开始新手教学吧。

entries.english: The elder says Spiders are spinning webs on the outer walls of the town and has asked us to take care of them. Although the request was made to the Shadow Phantom Guardians, I believe the job is suitable for travelers who are just starting out on their journey. Will you accept this quest? (Level 1-14)
entries.zh-CN: 长老说，蜘蛛在城镇外墙上结网，请我们处理。虽然委托交给了幻影守护者，但我觉得这份工作很适合刚踏上旅程的冒险者。你愿意接受这个任务吗？（等级1-14）

entries.english: It sounds like an easy job...
entries.zh-CN: 听起来很容易……

entries.english: I accept your quest. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 我接受你的委托。（接受）

entries.english: Hunting down measly Spiders is beneath me. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 区区蜘蛛，不值得我出手。（拒绝）

entries.english: That's unfortunate. You shouldn't pass this up if you want fast growth.... Come see me again before you reach level 15 if you want to accept the quest. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 真遗憾。如果想快速成长，就不该错过这次机会……若改变主意，记得在达到15级之前回来找我。（任务已取消）

entries.english: Hunt down 10 Spiders from around town, and I'll give you a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭城镇周围的10只蜘蛛，回来后我会给你奖励。

entries.english: Plunderers...
entries.zh-CN: 劫掠者……

entries.english: I accept your quest. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 我接受你的委托。（接受）

entries.english: Plunderers are too much for me to handle. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 这些劫掠者不是我能对付的。（拒绝）

entries.english: That's unfortunate. You shouldn't pass up on this if you want fast growth.... Come see me again before you reach level 26 if you want to accept the request. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 真遗憾。如果想快速成长，就不该错过这次机会……若改变主意，记得在达到26级之前回来找我。（任务已取消）

entries.english: Defeat 15 Giants from near the Devias entrance (22, 45) on the east side of town and return to me for a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭15只巨人。它们位于城镇东侧通往冰风谷的入口（22, 45）附近，完成后回来领取奖励。

entries.english: Defeat 15 Liches from near the Dungeon entrance (159, 205) on the southwest side of town and return to me for a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭15只黑巫师。它们位于城镇西南侧地下城入口（159, 205）附近，完成后回来领取奖励。

entries.english: Defeat 15 Agons from near the south side (173, 222) of town and return to me for a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭15只亚昆。它们位于城镇南侧（173, 222）附近，完成后回来领取奖励。

entries.english: Defeat 15 Polluted Butterflies from near the tombstone (121, 156) on the north side of town and return to me for a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭15只 Polluted Butterfly。它们位于城镇北侧墓碑（121, 156）附近，完成后回来领取奖励。

entries.english: Our reconnaissance party reports that stolen supplies are being sent to Kundun's army. Please defeat the monsters controlling these plunderers while we ascertain the location of the supply route. Will you accept this quest? (Level 26-35)
entries.zh-CN: 侦察队报告，遭劫掠的物资正被运往昆顿军队。我们查明运输路线期间，请你消灭指挥这些劫掠者的怪物。你愿意接受这个任务吗？（等级26-35）

entries.english: Things are becoming serious....
entries.zh-CN: 事情越来越严重了……

entries.english: I accept your quest. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 我接受你的委托。（接受）

entries.english: I don't have the time. I'm sorry. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 对不起，我没有时间。（拒绝）

entries.english: That's unfortunate. You shouldn't pass up on this if you want fast growth.... Come see me again before you reach level 36 if you want to accept the request. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 真遗憾。如果想快速成长，就不该错过这次机会……若改变主意，记得在达到36级之前回来找我。（任务已取消）

entries.english: Defeat 20 Skeleton Warriors from near the Dungeon entrance (123, 227) on the southwest side of town and return to me for a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭20只骷髅战士。它们位于城镇西南侧地下城入口（123, 227）附近，完成后回来领取奖励。

entries.english: Defeat 20 Giants from near the Devias entrance (22, 45) on the east side of town and return to me for a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭20只巨人。它们位于城镇东侧通往冰风谷的入口（22, 45）附近，完成后回来领取奖励。

entries.english: Defeat 20 Stone Golems from near the southwest side (30, 214) of town and return to me for a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭20只石巨人。它们位于城镇西南侧（30, 214）附近，完成后回来领取奖励。

entries.english: The town's Shadow Phantom Soldier is looking for someone he can rely on to carry out quests both big and small. Go see the Shadow Phantom Soldier again.
entries.zh-CN: 城里的幻影导师正在寻找可靠的人，帮助处理大小委托。请再去见见他。

entries.english: Return to the Shadow Phantom Soldier after defeating 10 Spiders.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭10只蜘蛛后，返回幻影导师处。

entries.english: The town's Shadow Phantom Soldier is looking for someone he can rely on to carry out quests both big and small. Go see the Shadow Phantom Soldier again.
entries.zh-CN: 城里的幻影导师正在寻找可靠的人，帮助处理大小委托。请再去见见他。

entries.english: Return to the Shadow Phantom Soldier after defeating 15 Giants.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭15只巨人后，返回幻影导师处。

entries.english: Return to the Shadow Phantom Soldier after defeating 15 Liches.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭15只黑巫师后，返回幻影导师处。

entries.english: Return to the Shadow Phantom Soldier after defeating 15 Agons.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭15只亚昆后，返回幻影导师处。

entries.english: Return to the Shadow Phantom Soldier after defeating 15 Polluted Butterflies.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭15只 Polluted Butterfly 后，返回幻影导师处。

entries.english: The town's Shadow Phantom Soldier is looking for someone he can rely on to carry out quests both big and small. Go see the Shadow Phantom Soldier again.
entries.zh-CN: 城里的幻影导师正在寻找可靠的人，帮助处理大小委托。请再去见见他。

entries.zh-CN: 消灭20只骷髅战士后，返回幻影导师处。

entries.english: Return to the Shadow Phantom Soldier after defeating 20 Giants.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭20只巨人后，返回幻影导师处。

entries.english: Return to the Shadow Phantom Soldier after defeating 20 Stone Golems.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭20只石巨人后，返回幻影导师处。

entries.english: Spider Hunt!
entries.zh-CN: 猎杀蜘蛛！

entries.english: Dispose of the Plunderers' Leader!
entries.zh-CN: 消灭劫掠者首领！

entries.english: Gain'Hero status'!
entries.zh-CN: 获得英雄资格！

entries.english: Secret of'Dark Stone'
entries.zh-CN: 暗黑之石的秘密

entries.english: Evidence of Strength
entries.zh-CN: 实力的证明

entries.english: Did you launch the Character Stats window?;That window contains the character's name and level, the name of the current server, and character statuses.
entries.zh-CN: 打开角色属性窗口了吗？;这里显示角色名称、等级、当前服务器名称和各项属性。

entries.english: ...There's nothing to it. But I would like to learn more....
entries.zh-CN: ……这很简单，不过我还想多了解一些……

entries.english: Can you explain in more detail?
entries.zh-CN: 能再详细讲讲吗？

entries.english: We have much to cover. Let's move on to the next step.
entries.zh-CN: 要学的还很多，继续下一步吧。

entries.english: I'll explain this in more detail. What else do you wish to know?
entries.zh-CN: 我再详细说明一下。你还想了解什么？

entries.english: ...I wish to learn about...
entries.zh-CN: ……我想了解……

entries.english: EXP Points and Leveling Up
entries.zh-CN: 经验值与升级

entries.english: Character and Server Selection
entries.zh-CN: 角色与服务器选择

entries.english: Points and Status
entries.zh-CN: 属性点与角色属性

entries.english: Gain EXP points to level up.;You can find out how many more points you need to reach the next level by checking your Character Stats window or the EXP bar located at the bottom of your screen.;The bar is divided into ten segments, and filling them up will elevate you to the next level.
entries.zh-CN: 获得经验值即可升级。;查看角色属性窗口或屏幕底部的经验条，就能知道距离下一级还差多少经验。;经验条分为十格，全部填满后即可升级。

entries.english: ...Is that right? And then I'd like to learn about...
entries.zh-CN: ……原来如此。接下来我想了解……

entries.english: Character and Server Selection
entries.zh-CN: 角色与服务器选择

entries.english: Points and Status
entries.zh-CN: 属性点与角色属性

entries.english: You've explained enough. Let's continue with the tutorial.
entries.zh-CN: 已经讲得很清楚了，继续教学吧。

entries.english: The Character Stats window will tell you the name of your character, the name of the current server, and your character's class. It's possible to connect to different channels within a single server using the same character.;There are four basic character classes: the Elf, the Dark Knight, the Dark Wizard, and the Summoner. Reach level 220 with any of these basic characters to unlock the Magic Gladiator, and level 250 to unlock the Dark Lord.
entries.zh-CN: 角色属性窗口会显示角色名称、当前服务器名称和职业。同一角色可以进入同一服务器的不同线路。;基础职业有弓箭手、剑士、魔法师和召唤术师。任一基础角色达到220级可解锁魔剑士，达到250级可解锁圣导师。

entries.english: Leveling up will earn you points. These points can be used to enhance your strength, agility, stamina, and energy and thereby affect your damage, defense, HP, and MP levels, respectively.;Carefully use these points, for how you develop your character will determine its combat characteristics and the types of weapons and skills it can use.
entries.zh-CN: 升级会获得属性点，可用于提升力量、敏捷、体力和智力，影响攻击、防御、生命和魔法等能力。;请谨慎分配。角色的成长方向决定战斗特点，以及能够使用的武器和技能。

entries.english: The Inventory window will display the items you have and the equipments you are wearing.;Click on an item to change its position or, if it's a consumable, right-click on it to use it. Did you get all that?
entries.zh-CN: 背包窗口显示你拥有和已装备的物品。;点击物品可以移动位置；消耗品可右键使用。明白了吗？

entries.english: Of course I did.
entries.zh-CN: 当然明白。

entries.english: Quick, on to the next step!
entries.zh-CN: 快继续下一步吧！

entries.english: You are full of zeal! Very well. Let's try adding an item to your inventory. Take the Zen I just gave you and purchase 5 apples from a merchant.
entries.zh-CN: 你真有干劲！好，试着往背包里添点东西。用我刚给你的金币，向商人购买5个苹果。

entries.english: Finally, a quest! You want me to buy 5 apples from a merchant?
entries.zh-CN: 终于有任务了！是向商人购买5个苹果吗？

entries.english: Excellent! I will be back in a flash.
entries.zh-CN: 好！我马上回来。

entries.english: Where can I find a merchant?
entries.zh-CN: 商人在哪里？

entries.english: Apples can be purchased from potion merchants. In Lorencia, look for Potion Girl Amy, who is located across the bridge (128,85). In Elveland, look for Silvia, who is in the 1 o'clock direction from the center of the square (45,227). In Noria, look for Elf Lala, who is slightly to the north from the town's center (172,124).
entries.zh-CN: 药水商人出售苹果。勇者大陆的少女安娜 在桥对面（128,85）；幻术园的 Silvia 在广场中心1点钟方向（45,227）；仙踪林的精灵安吉拉在城镇中心稍北处（172,124）。

entries.english: ...Finding a merchant is more difficult than I thought.
entries.zh-CN: ……找商人比想象中难啊。

entries.english: How do I check coordinates?
entries.zh-CN: 怎样查看坐标？

entries.english: The character's current coordinates are shown on the top left corner of the screen. Movement in the �� or �� direction changes the first number, and movement in the �� or �� direction the second.
entries.zh-CN: 屏幕左上角显示角色当前坐标。沿↖或↘方向移动会改变第一个数字，沿↗或↙方向移动会改变第二个数字。

entries.english: It's possible to find out the location of myself and others using coordinates? Amazing!
entries.zh-CN: 坐标能帮助确认自己和别人的位置？真方便！

entries.english: Loud and clear! Give me the next quest!
entries.zh-CN: 明白了！给我下一个任务吧！

entries.english: Go find the merchant in town and bring back 5 apples.;The NPC's name will be shown in light blue, and the point symbol will turn into a tooth symbol when you scroll over it with your mouse.
entries.zh-CN: 去找城里的商人，买回5个苹果。;NPC 名称显示为浅蓝色，鼠标移到其身上时，指针会变成齿形标记。

entries.english: Look at the right side of your screen. Do you see the apples you just bought? Adding a potion to the Inventory will automatically register it.;Press the Q button to use apples, potions, and other HP recovery items and the W button to use MP recovery items.
entries.zh-CN: 看屏幕右侧，看到刚买的苹果了吗？药水放入背包后会自动登记。;按 Q 键使用苹果、药水等生命恢复物品；按 W 键使用魔法恢复物品。

entries.english: Whoa! That's really convenient!
entries.zh-CN: 哇，真方便！

entries.english: Continue the conversation.
entries.zh-CN: 继续交谈。

entries.english: Since you now have potions, would you like to leave the safe zone and do some real hunting? Are you ready?
entries.zh-CN: 现在有药水了，要不要离开安全区，真正去打怪？准备好了吗？

entries.english: Great! I finally get the chance to show off what I can do.
entries.zh-CN: 好！终于能大显身手了。

entries.english: Excellent! What is the name of the monster you want me to hunt down?
entries.zh-CN: 太好了！要我消灭什么怪物？

entries.english: Explain potions to me once more.
entries.zh-CN: 请再讲一遍药水的用法。

entries.english: Go beyond the walls of Noria and hunt down 3 Chain Scorpions.;If you find yourself in trouble, press the Q button to recover your HP. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.
entries.zh-CN: 走出仙踪林城墙，消灭3只勾尾蝎。;遇到危险就按 Q 键恢复生命。我相信你能完成这次狩猎。

entries.english: Go beyond the walls of Lorencia and hunt down 3 Budge Dragons.;If you find yourself in trouble, press the Q button to recover your HP. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.
entries.zh-CN: 走出勇者大陆城墙，消灭3只幼龙。;遇到危险就按 Q 键恢复生命。我相信你能完成这次狩猎。

entries.english: Go beyond the walls of Elveland and hunt down 3 Strange Rabbits.;If you find yourself in trouble, press the Q button to recover your HP. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.
entries.zh-CN: 走出幻术园城墙，消灭3只 Strange Rabbit。;遇到危险就按 Q 键恢复生命。我相信你能完成这次狩猎。

entries.english: I see you've successfully completed your first hunt! Did you find it difficult? Hunting monsters will earn you EXP points, drop items, and Zens.;You can pick up items dropped by defeated monsters using the mouse or automatically by pressing the space bar.
entries.zh-CN: 第一次狩猎顺利完成了！觉得难吗？击杀怪物能获得经验，还会掉落物品和金币。;你可以用鼠标拾取掉落物，也可以按空格键自动拾取。

entries.english: Did you say the space bar?
entries.zh-CN: 你说的是空格键？

entries.english: That will surely make things easier. Do you have any other tips?
entries.zh-CN: 这可方便多了。还有其他窍门吗？

entries.english: I already knew that. What's the next quest?
entries.zh-CN: 这个我已经知道了。下一个任务是什么？

entries.english: Also, if you find yourself far away from a town or cornered while on a hunt, the Town Portal Scroll can come in really handy. Are you familiar with using it?
entries.zh-CN: 狩猎时远离城镇或陷入困境，回城卷轴会很有用。你知道怎样使用吗？

entries.english: ...Town Portal Scroll?
entries.zh-CN: ……回城卷轴？

entries.english: What is this Town Portal Scroll?
entries.zh-CN: 回城卷轴是什么？

entries.english: Of course I know. What's the next quest?
entries.zh-CN: 当然知道。下一个任务是什么？

entries.english: Town Portal Scrolls can be purchased from potion merchants in towns. They are single-use items that will bring you back to the last town you visited.;Since we're on the subject, will you go and purchase a Town Portal Scroll from the merchant? It'll be easier to understand if you try it for yourself.
entries.zh-CN: 城里的药水商人出售回城卷轴。它是一次性物品，使用后回到最近去过的城镇。;既然说到了，不如去商人那里买一个亲自试试，这样更容易理解。

entries.english: ...Hmm. I didn't know such thing existed.
entries.zh-CN: ……嗯，我还不知道有这种东西。

entries.english: Very well. How many do I need to buy?
entries.zh-CN: 好，要买几个？

entries.english: Go see the potion merchant again and buy just 1 Town Portal Scroll.
entries.zh-CN: 再去找药水商人，买1个回城卷轴就够了。

entries.english: You've done well. Let's see to one more thing before I ask you to face tougher monsters. Talk to me again and receive a damage and defense increase buff.
entries.zh-CN: 做得好。在挑战更强的怪物之前，还有一件事。再和我交谈，领取提升攻击力和防御力的增益效果。

entries.english: A damage and defense increase buff? That sounds great!
entries.zh-CN: 提升攻击和防御？听起来不错！

entries.english: How do I get it?
entries.zh-CN: 怎样领取？

entries.english: Close the Quest window and click on me again. After that, select 'Receive damage and defense increase buff.' This buff is available to anyone under level 220.;After receiving the buff, you will see an icon on the top left corner of the screen, a blue light effect surrounding the character, and have one hour of enhanced damage and defense.
entries.zh-CN: 关闭任务窗口，再点击我，选择“领取攻击和防御增益”。220级以下的角色都可以领取。;获得后，屏幕左上角会出现图标，角色周围会有蓝光，攻击和防御提升效果持续一小时。

entries.english: Excellent! It's time for the next quest. Since you are now familiar with hunting, let's get you to go after a tougher monster.
entries.zh-CN: 很好！开始下一个任务。既然已经熟悉狩猎，就挑战更强的怪物吧。

entries.english: Just say the word!
entries.zh-CN: 尽管吩咐！

entries.english: Excellent! What is the name of the monster you want me to hunt down?
entries.zh-CN: 太好了！要我消灭什么怪物？

entries.english: Go beyond the walls of Noria and hunt down 30 Beetle Monsters. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.
entries.zh-CN: 走出仙踪林城墙，消灭30只瓢虫怪。我相信你能完成这次狩猎。

entries.english: Go beyond the walls of Lorencia and hunt down 30 Hounds. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.
entries.zh-CN: 走出勇者大陆城墙，消灭30只猎犬怪。我相信你能完成这次狩猎。

entries.english: Go beyond the walls of Elveland and hunt down 30 Polluted Butterflies. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.
entries.zh-CN: 走出幻术园城墙，消灭30只 Polluted Butterfly。我相信你能完成这次狩猎。

entries.english: I see you've now mastered hunting. When you hunt monsters, you can employ normal attacks by left-clicking or use skill attacks by right-clicking.
entries.zh-CN: 看来你已经掌握狩猎技巧了。打怪时，鼠标左键进行普通攻击，右键使用技能攻击。

entries.english: ...Skill attacks?
entries.zh-CN: ……技能攻击？

entries.english: Where can I learn skills?
entries.zh-CN: 在哪里学习技能？

entries.english: This is common knowledge.
entries.zh-CN: 这些是常识。

entries.english: If you are an Agility Elf, whose priority is defense, you can equip a weapon and use its skills. If you are an Energy Elf, whose priority is wizardry, you can purchase orbs to learn skills.
entries.zh-CN: 注重防御的敏捷弓箭手可以装备武器，使用武器自带技能；注重魔法的智力弓箭手可以购买技能石学习技能。

entries.english: ...How do I do it?
entries.zh-CN: ……具体怎么做？

entries.english: I want to be an Elf who focuses on defense!
entries.zh-CN: 我想成为注重防御的弓箭手！

entries.english: I want to be an Elf who focuses on wizardry!
entries.zh-CN: 我想成为注重魔法的弓箭手！

entries.english: I don't want to decide right now. Just describe them for me.
entries.zh-CN: 我还不想决定，先介绍一下吧。

entries.english: So you've decided to become an Agility Elf, a class for whom defense is crucial. Agility Elves are unique in that they employ splendid bow skills. Let me give you a weapon to use so that you can understand better.
entries.zh-CN: 你选择了注重防御的敏捷弓箭手。敏弓擅长华丽的弓术，我给你一把武器，试用后就能了解。

entries.english: So you've decided to become an Energy Elf, a class for whom wizardry is crucial. Energy Elves are unique in that they employ a variety of summoning and magic spells. Let me give you an orb as a gift so that you can understand what I mean.
entries.zh-CN: 你选择了注重魔法的智力弓箭手。智弓擅长各种召唤和魔法，我送你一颗技能石，让你亲自体会。

entries.english: Dark Knights are unique in that they are powerful swordsmen who rely on both weapons and orbs. Let me give you a weapon to use so that you can understand better.
entries.zh-CN: 剑士擅长强力剑术，既依靠武器，也通过技能石学习技能。我给你一把武器，试用后就能了解。

entries.english: Dark Wizards are unique in that they are capable of mastering various magic spells from scrolls and parchments. Let me give you a scroll as a gift so that you can understand what I mean.
entries.zh-CN: 魔法师可通过魔法书和卷轴掌握多种魔法。我送你一本魔法书，让你亲自体会。

entries.english: Summoners are unique in that they are capable of mastering various magic spells from scrolls and parchments. Let me give you a scroll as a gift so that you can understand what I mean.
entries.zh-CN: 召唤术师可通过魔法书和卷轴掌握多种魔法。我送你一本魔法书，让你亲自体会。

entries.english: The weapon I gave you is a crossbow. To equip it, load the crossbow item to the equipment slot in your Inventory. Go ahead and equip it.
entries.zh-CN: 我给你的武器是一把弩。把背包中的弩放到装备栏就能装备，试试看。

entries.english: The orb I gave you will teach you the Summon Goblin skill. Right-click on the item to learn the skill. Go ahead and learn the skill.
entries.zh-CN: 我给你的技能石可以学习召唤哥布林。右键点击物品即可学习，试试看。

entries.english: The weapon I gave you is a Double Axe. To equip it, load the Double Axe item to the equipment slot in your Inventory. Go ahead and equip it.
entries.zh-CN: 我给你的武器是双刃斧。把背包中的双刃斧放到装备栏就能装备，试试看。

entries.english: The scroll I gave you will teach you the Fire Ball skill. Right-click on the item to learn the skill. Go ahead and learn the skill.
entries.zh-CN: 我给你的魔法书可以学习火球术。右键点击物品即可学习，试试看。

entries.english: If you are equipped with a weapon imbued with a skill, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.;Can you see the numbered slots at the bottom center of the screen? Click on the icon outlined in green, to the right of the number five slot.
entries.zh-CN: 装备带技能的武器后，可在技能窗口选择该技能使用。;看到屏幕底部中央带数字的栏位了吗？点击第五格右侧、带绿色边框的图标。

entries.english: After learning a skill from an orb, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.;Can you see the numbered slots at the bottom center of the screen? Click on the icon outlined in green, to the right of the number five slot.
entries.zh-CN: 通过技能石学习技能后，可在技能窗口选择该技能使用。;看到屏幕底部中央带数字的栏位了吗？点击第五格右侧、带绿色边框的图标。

entries.english: After learning a skill from a scroll, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.;Can you see the numbered slots at the bottom center of the screen? Click on the icon outlined in green, to the right of the number five slot.
entries.zh-CN: 通过魔法书学习技能后，可在技能窗口选择该技能使用。;看到屏幕底部中央带数字的栏位了吗？点击第五格右侧、带绿色边框的图标。

entries.english: ...The icon next to the number 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 slots....
entries.zh-CN: ……就是1、2、3、4、5号栏位旁边的图标……

entries.english: I got it!
entries.zh-CN: 明白了！

entries.english: You've done well. The Triple Shot skill should now be one of the skills you can use. Click on the icon.;Did the skill icon on the right switch to Triple Shot? When you're hunting monsters, simply right-click on the mouse to use the assigned skill.
entries.zh-CN: 做得好。现在可用技能中应该有多重箭，点击它的图标。;右侧技能图标变成多重箭了吗？狩猎时右键点击鼠标，就能使用选中的技能。

entries.english: You've done well. The Summon Goblin skill should now be one of the skills you can use. Click on the icon.;Did the skill icon on the right switch to Summon Goblin? When you're hunting monsters, simply right-click on the mouse to use the assigned skill.
entries.zh-CN: 做得好。现在可用技能中应该有召唤哥布林，点击它的图标。;右侧技能图标变成召唤哥布林了吗？狩猎时右键点击鼠标，就能使用选中的技能。

entries.english: You've done well. The Falling Slash skill should now be one of the skills you can use. Click on the icon.;Did the skill icon on the right switch to Falling Slash? When you're hunting monsters, simply right-click on the mouse to use the assigned skill.
entries.zh-CN: 做得好。现在可用技能中应该有Falling Slash，点击它的图标。;右侧技能图标变成Falling Slash了吗？狩猎时右键点击鼠标，就能使用选中的技能。

entries.english: You've done well. The Fire Ball skill should now be one of the skills you can use. Click on the icon.;Did the skill icon on the right switch to Fire Ball? When you're hunting monsters, simply right-click on the mouse to use the assigned skill.
entries.zh-CN: 做得好。现在可用技能中应该有火球术，点击它的图标。;右侧技能图标变成火球术了吗？狩猎时右键点击鼠标，就能使用选中的技能。

entries.english: I learned a skill!
entries.zh-CN: 我学会技能了！

entries.english: Where can I learn more skills?
entries.zh-CN: 在哪里能学到更多技能？

entries.english: Elves can learn additional skills by going to Noria and purchasing orbs from Elf Lala (173,124) or weapons from Eo the Craftsman (195,123).
entries.zh-CN: 弓箭手可到仙踪林，向精灵安吉拉（173,124）购买技能石，或向工艺尤达（195,123）购买武器，学习更多技能。

entries.english: Dark Knights can learn additional skills by going to Lorencia and purchasing orbs from Pasi the Mage (119,112). After purchasing an orb, right-click on it to learn the skill.
entries.zh-CN: 剑士可到勇者大陆，向魔导师帕希（119,112）购买技能石。买到后右键点击即可学习。

entries.english: Dark Wizards can learn additional skills by going to Lorencia and purchasing scrolls from Pasi the Mage (119,112) or weapons from Hanzo the Blacksmith (116,142).
entries.zh-CN: 魔法师可到勇者大陆，向魔导师帕希（119,112）购买魔法书，或向铁匠汉斯（116,142）购买武器，学习更多技能。

entries.english: Summoners can learn additional skills by going to Elveland and purchasing scrolls from Marce (36,218). After purchasing a scroll, right-click on it to learn the skill.
entries.zh-CN: 召唤术师可到幻术园，向 Marce（36,218）购买魔法书。买到后右键点击即可学习。

entries.english: ...I see it pays to know a lot of NPCs.
entries.zh-CN: ……看来多认识些 NPC 很有用。

entries.english: I understand well. What's the next quest?
entries.zh-CN: 明白了。下一个任务是什么？

entries.english: We're nearing the end of our tutorial. Now that you have a skill, it'll make sense for you to build more combat experience. Come back when you reach a certain level, and I will give you a Uniria as a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 教学快结束了。既然学会了技能，就再积累些战斗经验吧。达到指定等级后回来，我会奖励你一匹独角兽。

entries.english: ...Uniria?
entries.zh-CN: ……独角兽？

entries.english: What's a Uniria?
entries.zh-CN: 独角兽是什么？

entries.english: What level do I need to be?
entries.zh-CN: 要达到多少级？

entries.english: Uniria is a mount item you can use out in the battle field. Equip it to the top left corner of your Inventory window for faster travel throughout the battle field.
entries.zh-CN: 独角兽是野外使用的坐骑。将它装备到背包窗口左上角的栏位，就能更快地在野外移动。

entries.english: ...That's fantastic!
entries.zh-CN: ……太棒了！

entries.english: What level do I need to be?
entries.zh-CN: 要达到多少级？

entries.english: Come back once you've reached level 25.;I will then reward you with a Uniria as a gift.
entries.zh-CN: 达到25级后再回来。;到时我会送你一匹独角兽。

entries.english: You've truly become a fine warrior. I'm sure the queen herself will be proud of you. Truth be told, she has arranged a few items for warriors such as you.
entries.zh-CN: 你已经成长为出色的勇士，女王也会为你骄傲。其实，她为像你这样的勇士准备了一些礼物。

entries.english: ...The queen is very thoughtful!
entries.zh-CN: ……女王真体贴！

entries.english: Continue listening.
entries.zh-CN: 继续听下去。

entries.english: I will give you the queen's gifts if you pass a test to see if there's anything else you need to know and if you have the basic knowledge to travel throughout the MU realm. How about it?
entries.zh-CN: 先接受一个测试，看看你是否掌握了在奇迹大陆冒险的基本知识，还有什么需要补充。通过后就能领取女王的礼物，怎么样？

entries.english: Hmm...a test...
entries.zh-CN: 嗯……测试……

entries.english: Excellent! Bring on the test!
entries.zh-CN: 好！开始测试吧！

entries.english: I'd rather you give me the gifts without the test.
entries.zh-CN: 不如跳过测试，直接给我礼物吧。

entries.english: The test is simple enough, and it won't matter if you don't get everything right. If you do, however, there's a small bonus gift.;Are you sure you don't want to take the test?
entries.zh-CN: 测试很简单，没全答对也没关系；如果全部答对，还能多拿一份小礼物。;你真的不想试试吗？

entries.english: ...A bonus gift if I answer all the questions right?
entries.zh-CN: ……全部答对还有额外礼物？

entries.english: Excellent! Bring on the test!
entries.zh-CN: 好！开始测试吧！

entries.english: I'll just take the queen's gifts without taking the test.
entries.zh-CN: 我不参加测试，直接领取女王的礼物。

entries.english: Here's your first question.;How do you trade with a character that's in front of you?
entries.zh-CN: 第一道题。;怎样与面前的角色交易？

entries.english: ...trade...
Press D and select Trade or type in '/trade' in the Chat window.
entries.zh-CN: 按 D 选择交易，或在聊天框输入“/trade”。

entries.english: Press D and select Trade or type in '/exchange' in the Chat window.
entries.zh-CN: 按 D 选择交易，或在聊天框输入“/exchange”。

entries.english: Press D and select Trade or type in '/invite' in the Chat window.
entries.zh-CN: 按 D 选择交易，或在聊天框输入“/invite”。

entries.english: That is correct! Pressing D will give you access to various commands, including Trade, Party, Buy, and Follow. Use these commands well.
entries.zh-CN: 答对了！按 D 可打开交易、组队、购买、跟随等指令。好好利用它们吧。

entries.english: Ah, you've answered incorrectly. To trade, press D and select Trade or face the character and type in '/trade' in the Chat window. Let's skip to the next question.
entries.zh-CN: 答错了。交易时按 D 选择交易，或面对目标角色，在聊天框输入“/trade”。继续下一题吧。

entries.english: When you want to form a party with a character, face that character and enter '/party' in the Chat window. What do you do if you don't want to receive party requests?
entries.zh-CN: 组队时，面对目标角色，在聊天框输入“/party”。如果不想接收组队邀请，该怎么办？

entries.english: Party request?
entries.zh-CN: 组队邀请？

entries.english: Type in '/off' in the Chat window.
entries.zh-CN: 在聊天框输入“/off”。

entries.english: Type in '/Request off' in the Chat window.
entries.zh-CN: 在聊天框输入“/Request off”。

entries.english: Type in '/Party off' in the Chat window.
entries.zh-CN: 在聊天框输入“/Party off”。

entries.english: That is correct! If you don't want to receive party requests while hunting, simply type in '/Request off' in the Chat window. To start receiving party requests again, type in '/Request on' in the Chat window.
entries.zh-CN: 答对了！打怪时不想接收组队邀请，可在聊天框输入“/Request off”；想重新接收时，输入“/Request on”。

entries.english: Ah, you've answered incorrectly. Type in '/Request off' in the Chat window to turn down party requests. To start receiving party requests again, type in '/Request on' in the Chat window. Let's skip to the next question.
entries.zh-CN: 答错了。在聊天框输入“/Request off”可拒绝组队邀请，输入“/Request on”可重新接收。继续下一题吧。

entries.english: Whispers are used to talk to friends who are far away or to pass on private messages. Which button is used to send whispers from the Chat window?
entries.zh-CN: 密语可与远处的朋友交谈或发送私人消息。在聊天窗口按哪个键发送密语？

entries.english: ...Whispers...
From the Chat window, use the Shift button.
entries.zh-CN: 在聊天窗口按 Shift 键。

entries.english: From the Chat window, use the Ctrl button.
entries.zh-CN: 在聊天窗口按 Ctrl 键。

entries.english: From the Chat window, use the Tab button.
entries.zh-CN: 在聊天窗口按 Tab 键。

entries.english: That is correct! When you want to talk to a friend and you know his or her ID, or if you want to pass on private messages, send whispers by using Tab from the Chat window.
entries.zh-CN: 答对了！知道朋友的角色名，或想发送私人消息时，可在聊天窗口按 Tab 键发送密语。

entries.english: Ah, you've answered incorrectly. When you want to talk to a friend and you know his or her ID, or if you want to pass on private messages, send whispers by using Tab from the Chat window. Let's skip to the next question.
entries.zh-CN: 答错了。知道朋友的角色名，或想发送私人消息时，可在聊天窗口按 Tab 键发送密语。继续下一题吧。

entries.english: You'll need to regularly repair your equipments since their durability will diminish as you hunt monsters. When you reach a certain level, you will be able to repair your equipments directly from the Inventory window. What level is that?
entries.zh-CN: 打怪会降低装备耐久度，需要定期修理。达到一定等级后，可以直接在背包窗口修理装备。是多少级？

entries.english: Too easy! To repair equipment without the help of an NPC, I need to be at...
entries.zh-CN: 太简单了！不找 NPC、自己修理装备需要达到……

entries.english: Level 30
Level 50
Level 75
That is correct! You can have your equipment repaired by Hanzo the Blacksmith (117,140) in Lorencia, Rhea (30, 235) in Elveland, or Eo the Craftsman (194, 123) in Noria. Solicit their services often.
entries.zh-CN: 答对了！勇者大陆的铁匠汉斯（117,140）、幻术园的 Rhea（30, 235）和仙踪林的工艺尤达（194, 123）都能修理装备，记得常去。

entries.english: Ah, you've answered incorrectly.; You'll be able to repair your equipment with ease by using the Repair button from the Inventory window once you reach level 50. However, this is more costly than repairing through an NPC.;Let's move on to the next question.
entries.zh-CN: 答错了。;达到50级后，可使用背包里的修理按钮修理装备，但费用比找 NPC 更高。;继续下一题。

entries.english: The higher the level, the more distance you get to travel. Using the M button, however, it's possible to travel to distant areas in a flash. What is the minimum level you need to be and the amount of Zen you need in order to enter the Dungeon?
entries.zh-CN: 等级越高，能去的地方越多。按 M 键还能快速移动到远处。进入地下城最低需要多少等级和金币？

entries.english: Hmm...First, press M and then...
entries.zh-CN: 嗯……先按 M，然后……

entries.english: Level 10 and 2,000 Zens
Level 30 and 3000 Zens
Level 50 and 4000 Zens

That is correct! In the MU world, you can use the M button to travel with ease, provided that your level is high enough and you have enough money for the destination.;Discovering areas that's right for your level, and hunting there, can also be very fun.
entries.zh-CN: 答对了！只要达到目的地要求的等级并备足金币，就能按 M 键快速移动。;寻找适合自己等级的区域狩猎，也很有趣。

entries.english: Ah, you've answered incorrectly. Use M to find out and travel to accessible areas with ease. Discovering areas that are right for your level, and hunting there, can also be very fun.;On to the next question.
entries.zh-CN: 答错了。按 M 键可查看并快速前往可进入的地区。寻找适合自己等级的区域狩猎，也很有趣。;继续下一题。

entries.english: In MU, it's possible to combine different items to create new ones. In fact, trying out different combinations of items adds a whole new dimension to MU.;Whom should you seek out in order to combine items?
entries.zh-CN: 在奇迹中，不同物品可以合成新物品，尝试各种组合也是一大乐趣。;合成物品应该找谁？

entries.english: The answer is obvious!
entries.zh-CN: 答案很明显！

entries.english: The Goblin NPC in Noria.
entries.zh-CN: 仙踪林的玛雅哥布林。

entries.english: The Seed Master NPC in Elveland.
entries.zh-CN: 幻术园的种子大师。

entries.english: The Trainer NPC in Lorencia.
entries.zh-CN: 勇者大陆的训兽师。

entries.english: That is correct! With the help of NPCs in the towns, you can not only combine items, but also enhance your armor by adding jewels to it and much more. Make sure to visit them all.
entries.zh-CN: 答对了！城里的 NPC 不仅能帮你合成物品，还能使用宝石强化防具等。记得都去拜访一下。

entries.english: Ah, you've answered incorrectly. Take the items, ingredients, and the money you need for combining to the Goblin in Noria to create a new item. Make sure to try it at least once. Let's skip to the next question.
entries.zh-CN: 答错了。带齐合成所需的物品、材料和金币，去找仙踪林的玛雅哥布林，即可合成新物品。一定要试试。继续下一题吧。

entries.english: Congratulations. You've completed the tutorial. Take this Ring of Hero and this Ring of Warrior. They are gifts to you from the queen.
entries.zh-CN: 恭喜完成新手教学！收下英雄之戒和战士之戒，这是女王送你的礼物。

entries.english: ...Finally, the tutorial's finished!
entries.zh-CN: ……教学终于结束了！

entries.english: Ring of Hero? Ring of Warrior? What are they?
entries.zh-CN: 英雄之戒？战士之戒？是什么？

entries.english: Thank you!
entries.zh-CN: 谢谢！

entries.english: Ah, I'll have to go far back in time to explain that.;Runedil, the former queen of Elves, was saddened by the loss of all the new warriors of the MU empire, who gave up their lives to constant warring.
entries.zh-CN: 这要从很久以前说起。;精灵前任女王 Runedil 看着奇迹帝国的新战士在连年战争中牺牲，悲痛不已。

entries.english: Continue listening.
entries.zh-CN: 继续听下去。

entries.english: So she imbued rings with the power of the Elves and gave them to warriors in honor of Muren's practice of handing out warriors' rings bearing the emperor's crest.
entries.zh-CN: 为了纪念 Muren 向战士颁发带有皇帝纹章的戒指这一传统，她将精灵的力量注入戒指，赠予战士。

entries.english: Continue listening.
entries.zh-CN: 继续听下去。

entries.english: That custom all but disappeared when peace finally came. However, Kundun and the chaos he brought motivated Erin Gustiv, the reigning queen of the Elves, to reinstate it.
entries.zh-CN: 和平降临后，这个习俗几乎消失。但昆顿带来的混乱促使现任精灵女王 Erin Gustiv 恢复了它。

entries.english: Ah. So that's what happened....
entries.zh-CN: 啊，原来是这样……

entries.english: Continue listening.
entries.zh-CN: 继续听下去。

entries.english: When a warrior who possesses them becomes a consummate expert in his or her art, these rings transform into unique items that will help their master attain greater heights.
entries.zh-CN: 当持有戒指的战士精通自己的技艺时，戒指会化为独特的物品，帮助主人变得更强。

entries.english: Oh! That will surely come in handy!
entries.zh-CN: 哦！一定很有用！

entries.english: Take the rings.
entries.zh-CN: 收下戒指。

entries.english: You'll be able to use the Ring of Hero at level 40 and the Ring of Warrior at level 80. Dropping the rings will break their seal and transform them into items.;Next time we meet, I sincerely hope to see a mightier warrior before me. Go now and build your experience and strength and free this world from Kundun's grasp!;(You've completed the tutorial.)
entries.zh-CN: 英雄之戒可在40级使用，战士之戒可在80级使用。将戒指丢到地上即可解除封印，化为物品。;真心希望下次见面时，你已更加强大。去积累经验、磨炼实力，让世界摆脱昆顿的魔掌吧！;（新手教学已完成。）

entries.english: Warrior! Welcome.
entries.zh-CN: 勇士，欢迎你！

entries.english: I will guide you through MU game play.
entries.zh-CN: 我会为你介绍奇迹的基本玩法。

entries.english: While in a town, seek out the Shadow Phantom Soldier NPC.
entries.zh-CN: 在城镇中寻找幻影导师 NPC。

entries.english: I will guide you through MU game play.
entries.zh-CN: 我会为你介绍奇迹的基本玩法。

entries.english: This is the end of the tutorial. Please enjoy your MU experience.
entries.zh-CN: 新手教学到此结束，祝你在奇迹中玩得愉快。

entries.english: While in a town, seek out the Shadow Phantom Soldier NPC.
entries.zh-CN: 在城镇中寻找幻影导师 NPC。

entries.english: My name is Olga. My fellow comrades from the Shadow Phantom Guardians and I serve Erin Gustiv, the Elf queen. I am happy to make your acquaintance.
entries.zh-CN: 我叫 Olga。我和幻影守护者的同伴们效忠于精灵女王 Erin Gustiv。很高兴认识你。

entries.english: My name is Olga. My fellow comrades from the Shadow Phantom Guardians and I serve Erin Gustiv, the Elf queen. I am happy to make your acquaintance.
entries.zh-CN: 我叫 Olga。我和幻影守护者的同伴们效忠于精灵女王 Erin Gustiv。很高兴认识你。

entries.english: I will teach you hunting and control commands through a simple tutorial.
entries.zh-CN: 我会通过简单的新手教学，教你打怪技巧和基本操作。

entries.english: Press C or click on the Character (C) button located on the bottom right of your screen to launch the Character Stats window.
entries.zh-CN: 按 C 键，或点击屏幕右下角的“角色（C）”按钮，打开角色属性窗口。

entries.english: The Character Stats window will tell you the name and level of your character, the name of the current server, and character status information.
entries.zh-CN: 角色属性窗口显示角色名称、等级、当前服务器名称和属性信息。

entries.english: The Character Stats window will tell you the name and level of your character, the name of the current server, and character status information.
entries.zh-CN: 角色属性窗口显示角色名称、等级、当前服务器名称和属性信息。

entries.english: Accumulate EXP points to level up. You can find out how many more points you need to reach the next level by checking your Character Stats window or the EXP bar located at the bottom of your screen.
entries.zh-CN: 积累经验值即可升级。查看角色属性窗口或屏幕底部的经验条，可了解距离下一级还差多少经验。

entries.english: The Character Stats window will tell you the name of your character, the name of the current server, and your character's class.
entries.zh-CN: 角色属性窗口显示角色名称、当前服务器名称和职业。

entries.english: Points gained from leveling up can be used to enhance your strength, agility, stamina, and energy, and thereby affect your damage, defense, HP, and MP levels, respectively.
entries.zh-CN: 升级获得的属性点可提升力量、敏捷、体力和智力，影响攻击、防御、生命和魔法等能力。

entries.english: Press the I button or click on the Inventory (I/V) button located on the bottom right to open your Inventory window.
entries.zh-CN: 按 I 键，或点击右下角的“背包（I/V）”按钮，打开背包窗口。

entries.english: The Inventory window will display the items you have and the equipment you are wearing.
entries.zh-CN: 背包窗口显示你拥有的物品和已装备的装备。

entries.english: Purchase and bring back 5 apples from a merchant.
entries.zh-CN: 向商人购买并带回5个苹果。

entries.english: Apples can be purchased from potion merchants. In Lorencia, look for Potion Girl Amy, who is located across the bridge (128,85). In Elveland, look for Silvia, who is in the 1 o'clock direction from the center of the square (45,227). In Noria, look for Elf Lala, who is slightly to the north from the town's center (172,124).
entries.zh-CN: 药水商人出售苹果。勇者大陆的少女安娜 在桥对面（128,85）；幻术园的 Silvia 在广场中心1点钟方向（45,227）；仙踪林的精灵安吉拉在城镇中心稍北处（172,124）。

entries.english: The character's current coordinates are shown on the top left corner of the screen. Movement in the �� or �� direction changes the first number, and movement in the �� or �� direction the second.
entries.zh-CN: 屏幕左上角显示角色当前坐标。沿↖或↘方向移动会改变第一个数字，沿↗或↙方向移动会改变第二个数字。

entries.english: Go find the merchant in town and bring back 5 apples.
entries.zh-CN: 寻找城里的商人，买回5个苹果。

entries.english: Press the Q button to use apples, potions, and other HP recovery items, and the W button to use MP recovery items.
entries.zh-CN: 按 Q 使用苹果、药水等生命恢复物品，按 W 使用魔法恢复物品。

entries.english: Let's get you some real combat experience.
entries.zh-CN: 去积累一些实战经验吧。

entries.english: Go beyond the walls of Noria and hunt down 3 Chain Scorpions.
entries.zh-CN: 走出仙踪林城墙，消灭3只勾尾蝎。

entries.english: Go beyond the walls of Lorencia and hunt down 3 Budge Dragons.
entries.zh-CN: 走出勇者大陆城墙，消灭3只幼龙。

entries.english: Go beyond the walls of Elveland and hunt down 3 Strange Rabbits.
entries.zh-CN: 走出幻术园城墙，消灭3只 Strange Rabbit。

entries.english: Hunting monsters will earn you EXP points, drop items, and Zens.
entries.zh-CN: 击杀怪物可获得经验，还会掉落物品和金币。

entries.english: If you find yourself far away from a town or cornered while on a hunt, the Town Portal Scroll can come in really handy.
entries.zh-CN: 狩猎时远离城镇或陷入困境，回城卷轴会很有用。

entries.english: Using a Town Portal Scroll will return you to the last town you visited.
entries.zh-CN: 使用回城卷轴可返回最近去过的城镇。

entries.english: Purchase and bring back 1 Town Portal Scroll.
entries.zh-CN: 购买并带回1个回城卷轴。

entries.english: Talk to me again and receive a damage and defense increase buff.
entries.zh-CN: 再和我交谈，领取攻击和防御增益。

entries.english: Close the Quest window and click on me again. After that, select 'Receive damage and defense increase buff.'
entries.zh-CN: 关闭任务窗口，再点击我，选择“领取攻击和防御增益”。

entries.english: After receiving the buff, you will see an icon on the top left corner of the screen, a blue light effect surrounding the character, and have one hour of enhanced damage and defense.
entries.zh-CN: 获得增益后，屏幕左上角出现图标，角色周围有蓝光，攻击和防御提升效果持续一小时。

entries.english: Go beyond the walls of Noria and hunt down 30 Beetle Monsters.
entries.zh-CN: 走出仙踪林城墙，消灭30只瓢虫怪。

entries.english: Go beyond the walls of Lorencia and hunt down 30 Hounds.
entries.zh-CN: 走出勇者大陆城墙，消灭30只猎犬怪。

entries.english: Go beyond the walls of Elveland and hunt down 30 Polluted Butterflies.
entries.zh-CN: 走出幻术园城墙，消灭30只 Polluted Butterfly。

entries.english: When you hunt monsters, you can employ normal attacks by left-clicking or use skill attacks by right-clicking.
entries.zh-CN: 打怪时，鼠标左键进行普通攻击，右键使用技能攻击。

entries.english: When you hunt monsters, you can employ normal attacks by left-clicking or use skill attacks by right-clicking.
entries.zh-CN: 打怪时，鼠标左键进行普通攻击，右键使用技能攻击。

entries.english: When you hunt monsters, you can employ normal attacks by left-clicking or use skill attacks by right-clicking.
entries.zh-CN: 打怪时，鼠标左键进行普通攻击，右键使用技能攻击。

entries.english: Agility Elves, whose priority is defense, can learn skills by equipping weapons, and Energy Elves, whose priority is wizardry, by purchasing orbs.
entries.zh-CN: 注重防御的敏弓通过装备武器使用技能，注重魔法的智弓通过购买技能石学习技能。

entries.english: Let me give you an Agility Elf weapon to use so that you can understand how skills work better.
entries.zh-CN: 我给你一把敏弓使用的武器，让你更好地了解技能。

entries.english: Let me give you an Energy Elf's orb to use so that you can understand how skills work better.
entries.zh-CN: 我给你一颗智弓使用的技能石，让你更好地了解技能。

entries.english: Try equipping the crossbow.
entries.zh-CN: 试着装备这把弩。

entries.english: Try learning the Summon Goblin skill.
entries.zh-CN: 试着学习召唤哥布林。

entries.english: If you are equipped with a weapon imbued with a skill, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.
entries.zh-CN: 装备带技能的武器后，可在技能窗口选择该技能使用。

entries.english: After learning a skill from an orb, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.
entries.zh-CN: 通过技能石学习技能后，可在技能窗口选择该技能使用。

entries.english: The Triple Shot skill should now be one of the skills you can use. Try clicking the icon.
entries.zh-CN: 现在可用技能中应该有多重箭，试着点击它的图标。

entries.english: The Summon Goblin skill should now be one of the skills you can use. Try clicking the icon.
entries.zh-CN: 现在可用技能中应该有召唤哥布林，试着点击它的图标。

entries.english: Elves can learn additional skills by going to Noria and purchasing orbs from Elf Lala (173,124) or weapons from Eo the Craftsman (195,123).
entries.zh-CN: 弓箭手可到仙踪林，向精灵安吉拉（173,124）购买技能石，或向工艺尤达（195,123）购买武器，学习更多技能。

entries.english: Let me give you a Dark Knight weapon to use so that you can understand better.
entries.zh-CN: 我给你一把剑士武器，让你亲自体会。

entries.english: Try equipping the Double Axe.
entries.zh-CN: 试着装备双刃斧。

entries.english: If you are equipped with a weapon imbued with a skill, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.
entries.zh-CN: 装备带技能的武器后，可在技能窗口选择该技能使用。

entries.english: The Falling Slash skill should now be one of the skills you can use. Try clicking the icon.
entries.zh-CN: 现在可用技能中应该有 Falling Slash，试着点击它的图标。

entries.english: Dark Knights can learn additional skills by going to Lorencia and purchasing scrolls from Pasi the Mage (119,112). After purchasing a scroll, right-click on it to learn the skill.
entries.zh-CN: 剑士可到勇者大陆，向魔导师帕希（119,112）购买卷轴，右键点击卷轴即可学习技能。

entries.english: Let me give you a Dark Wizard's scroll to use so that you can understand better.
entries.zh-CN: 我给你一本魔法师的魔法书，让你亲自体会。

entries.english: Go ahead and learn the Fire Ball skill.
entries.zh-CN: 试着学习火球术。

entries.english: After learning a skill from a scroll, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.
entries.zh-CN: 通过魔法书学习技能后，可在技能窗口选择该技能使用。

entries.english: The Fire Ball skill should now be one of the skills you can use. Try clicking the icon.
entries.zh-CN: 现在可用技能中应该有火球术，试着点击它的图标。

entries.english: Scrolls can be purchased from Pasi the Mage (119,112) in Lorencia and Marce (36,218) in Elveland.
entries.zh-CN: 可向勇者大陆的魔导师帕希（119,112）或幻术园的 Marce（36,218）购买魔法书。

entries.english: Scrolls can be purchased from Pasi the Mage (119,112) in Lorencia and Marce (36,218) in Elveland.
entries.zh-CN: 可向勇者大陆的魔导师帕希（119,112）或幻术园的 Marce（36,218）购买魔法书。

entries.english: Come back when you reach a certain level, and I will give you a Uniria as a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 达到指定等级后回来，我会奖励你一匹独角兽。

entries.english: Uniria is a mount item you can use out in the battle field. Equip it to the top left corner of your Inventory window for faster travel throughout the battle field.
entries.zh-CN: 独角兽是野外使用的坐骑。将它装备到背包窗口左上角的栏位，就能更快地在野外移动。

entries.english: Come back and see me once you reach level 25. I will give you a Uniria as a reward for your achievement.
entries.zh-CN: 达到25级后回来找我，我会奖励你一匹独角兽。

entries.english: I'll test you to see if you have the basic knowledge required for travel throughout the MU empire and give you the queen's gifts if you pass.
entries.zh-CN: 我会测试你是否掌握了在奇迹帝国冒险的基本知识，通过后即可领取女王的礼物。

entries.english: What do you do if you want to trade with a character who is in front of you?
entries.zh-CN: 怎样与面前的角色交易？

entries.english: Pressing D will give you access to various commands, including Trade, Party, Buy, and Follow. Use these commands well.
entries.zh-CN: 按 D 可打开交易、组队、购买、跟随等指令。好好利用它们吧。

entries.english: Let me give you a Summoner's scroll to use so that you can understand better.
entries.zh-CN: 我给你一本召唤术师的魔法书，让你亲自体会。

entries.english: What do you do if you don't want to receive party requests?
entries.zh-CN: 不想接收组队邀请时，该怎么办？

entries.english: If you don't want to receive party requests while hunting, simply type in 'Party off' in the Chat window. To start receiving party requests again, type in 'Request on' in the Chat window.
entries.zh-CN: 不想接收组队邀请，在聊天框输入“Party off”；重新接收时输入“Request on”。

entries.english: If you don't want to receive party requests while hunting, simply type in 'Party off' in the Chat window. To start receiving party requests again, type in 'Request on' in the Chat window.
entries.zh-CN: 不想接收组队邀请，在聊天框输入“Party off”；重新接收时输入“Request on”。

entries.english: Which button is used to send whispers from the Chat window?
entries.zh-CN: 在聊天窗口按哪个键发送密语？

entries.english: When you want to talk to a friend and you know his or her ID, or if you want to pass on private messages, send whispers by using Tab from the Chat window.
entries.zh-CN: 知道朋友的角色名，或想发送私人消息时，可在聊天窗口按 Tab 键发送密语。

entries.english: When you want to talk to a friend and you know his or her ID, or if you want to pass on private messages, send whispers by using Tab from the Chat window.

entries.english: When you reach a certain level, you will be able to repair your equipment directly from the Inventory window. What level is that?
entries.zh-CN: 达到多少级后，可以直接在背包窗口修理装备？

entries.english: You can have your equipment repaired by Hanzo the Blacksmith (117,140) in Lorencia, Rhea (30, 235) in Elveland, or Eo the Craftsman (194, 123) in Noria. Solicit their services often.
entries.zh-CN: 勇者大陆的铁匠汉斯（117,140）、幻术园的 Rhea（30, 235）和仙踪林的工艺尤达（194, 123）都能修理装备，记得常去。

entries.english: Using the M button, however, it's possible to travel to distant areas in a flash. What is the minimum level you need to be and the amount of Zen you need in order to enter the Dungeon?
entries.zh-CN: 按 M 可快速移动到远处。进入地下城最低需要多少等级和金币？

entries.english: In the MU world, you can use the M button to travel with ease, provided that your level is high enough and you have enough money for the destination. Discovering areas that are right for your level and hunting there can also be very fun.
entries.zh-CN: 只要达到目的地要求的等级并备足金币，就能按 M 快速移动。寻找适合自己等级的区域狩猎，也很有趣。

entries.english: With the help of NPCs in the towns, you can not only combine items, but also enhance your armor by adding jewels to it and much more. Make sure to visit them all.
entries.zh-CN: 城里的 NPC 不仅能合成物品，还能使用宝石强化防具等。记得都去拜访一下。

entries.english: Welcome to MU.;I'll assist you on your road to becoming a true warrior.
entries.zh-CN: 欢迎来到奇迹。;我会帮助你成长为真正的勇士。

entries.english: Receive damage and defense increase buff.
entries.zh-CN: 领取攻击和防御增益。

entries.english: Accept a quest.
entries.zh-CN: 接受任务。

entries.english: How do you do? I am Gregory, the Gens Duprian Steward. What is your business with our gens?
entries.zh-CN: 你好，我是 Duprian 家族管家 Gregory。你找我们家族有什么事？

entries.english: Ask about Gens Duprian.
entries.zh-CN: 询问 Duprian 家族。

entries.english: Ask about the gens dispute.
entries.zh-CN: 询问家族纷争。

entries.english: Join Gens Duprian.
entries.zh-CN: 加入 Duprian 家族。

entries.english: Leave Gens Duprian.
entries.zh-CN: 退出 Duprian 家族。

entries.english: Accept a gens quest.
entries.zh-CN: 接受家族任务。

entries.english: Gens Duprian is a guild of the greatest heroes in Arca and at its heart is the Duprian clan, the mightiest noble bloodline in MU. We are led by Duprian Winston, a knight who knows no equal in the whole of the MU empire.
entries.zh-CN: Duprian 家族汇聚了 Arca 最伟大的英雄，核心是奇迹最强大的贵族血脉 Duprian。我们的领袖 Duprian Winston，是帝国中无人能敌的骑士。

entries.english: Go back.
entries.zh-CN: 返回。

entries.english: Gens dispute��? Gens Vanert��s rebellion is more like it. The gens dispute started because of the greed of Vanert Reicht, the commanding knight of Gens Vanert. Exactly five years ago, a band of heroes who were searching in La Cleon for a stone with the power to seal away Kundun were slaughtered. At the time, we believed it was the work of Selupan, a giant spider and the ruler of La Cleon, but soon learned that it was actually Gens Vanert. It is the duty of our proud Gens Duprian champions to retaliate and fight.
entries.zh-CN: 家族纷争？不如说是 Vanert 的叛乱！纷争源于他们的统帅 Vanert Reicht 的贪婪。五年前，一群英雄在拉克里昂寻找封印昆顿的魔石时遭到屠杀。我们起初以为是当地统治者、冰霜巨蛛 所为，后来才发现凶手是 Vanert 家族。反击是我们 Duprian 勇士的职责。

entries.english: Oh! You wish to become a member of Gens Duprian? Share our virtues of honor and respect, and help in the fight to crush the greed of Gens Vanert and find the stone that will seal away Kundun.
entries.zh-CN: 你想加入 Duprian 家族？请秉持荣誉与尊重，与我们共同粉碎 Vanert 家族的贪欲，寻找能封印昆顿的魔石。

entries.english: Yes. I wish to join.
entries.zh-CN: 是的，我愿意加入。

entries.english: No. I will give it more thought.
entries.zh-CN: 不，我再考虑一下。

entries.english: If you leave the gens, your contribution will be reset.;Do you still wish to leave?
entries.zh-CN: 退出家族后，贡献度将清零。;仍要退出吗？

entries.english: Yes. I wish to leave.
entries.zh-CN: 是的，我要退出。

entries.english: Congratulations on becoming a member of Gens Duprian.  Much will be asked of you in the name of our cause. Come see me whenever you require assistance concerning the gens.
entries.zh-CN: 恭喜加入 Duprian 家族。为了共同的事业，我们会有很多事托付给你。需要家族方面的帮助时，随时来找我。

entries.english: You cannot join the gens.
entries.zh-CN: 无法加入家族。

entries.zh-CN: 无法退出家族。

entries.zh-CN: 达到50级才能加入家族。

entries.zh-CN: 你已经加入家族。

entries.english: Your guild is part of a different gens.

entries.english: You left the gens. Your contribution has been reset to 0.
entries.zh-CN: 你已退出家族，贡献度已重置为0。

entries.zh-CN: 盟主尚未加入家族。盟主必须先加入，你才能加入该家族。

entries.english: You cannot join a gens if you are a member of the guild alliance.
entries.zh-CN: 战盟联盟成员无法加入家族。

entries.english: The guild master cannot leave the gens.

entries.zh-CN: 你尚未加入家族，必须先加入才能退出。

entries.english: You have left the gens.
entries.zh-CN: 你已退出家族。

entries.english: You are a member of a different gens.
entries.zh-CN: 你属于另一个家族。

entries.english: You cannot join a gens while in a party.
entries.zh-CN: 组队状态下无法加入家族。

entries.english: What is your business with our gens? I am Conrad, the Gens Vanert Steward.
entries.zh-CN: 你找我们家族有什么事？我是 Vanert 家族管家 Conrad。

entries.english: Ask about Gens Vanert.
entries.zh-CN: 询问 Vanert 家族。

entries.english: Ask about the gens dispute.
entries.zh-CN: 询问家族纷争。

entries.english: Join Gens Vanert.
entries.zh-CN: 加入 Vanert 家族。

entries.english: Leave Gens Vanert.
entries.zh-CN: 退出 Vanert 家族。

entries.english: Accept a gens quest.
entries.zh-CN: 接受家族任务。

entries.english: Gens Vanert is a noble family led by Vanert Reicht, the greatest socialite in the whole of the MU empire. The master strives around the clock to put a stop to Duprian Winston and his dream of absolute rule over the empire.
entries.zh-CN: Vanert 家族由帝国最杰出的名流 Vanert Reicht 领导。主人日夜努力，阻止 Duprian Winston 独裁统治帝国的野心。

entries.english: Vanert Reicht may have conceded leadership of Noble Alliance Arca to Duprian Winston at the alliance's inception, but the master has always remained committed to eliminating the foul minions of Kundun and to the revival of the MU empire. Everyone knows about Duprian Winston's desires to subjugate the empire under his absolute rule. It's imperative that heroes like you help Vanert Reicht seal away Kundun and restore peace to the MU empire.
entries.zh-CN: 贵族联盟 Arca 成立时，Vanert Reicht 虽将领导权让给了 Duprian Winston，却始终致力于消灭昆顿的邪恶爪牙、复兴奇迹帝国。Duprian Winston 妄图独裁统治的野心人尽皆知。像你这样的英雄应协助 Vanert Reicht 封印昆顿，让帝国恢复和平。

entries.english: Hmm... you are a wise warrior. Go now and achieve great things in the name Gens Vanert, knowing that I will always be here to assist you.
entries.zh-CN: 嗯，你是位明智的勇士。以 Vanert 家族之名去建功立业吧，记住，我会一直在这里帮助你。

entries.english: Congratulations on becoming a member of Gens Vanert. Much will be asked of you in the name of our cause. Come see me whenever you require assistance concerning the gens.
entries.zh-CN: 恭喜加入 Vanert 家族。为了共同的事业，我们会有很多事托付给你。需要家族方面的帮助时，随时来找我。

entries.english: You cannot join a gens if you are a member of the guild alliance. Leave the guild alliance and try joining the gens again.
entries.zh-CN: 战盟联盟成员无法加入家族。请先退出战盟联盟，再尝试加入。

entries.english: Congratulations. You have contributed more to the cause of the gens than any other member. Duprian Winston rewards your accomplishments. I hope to see even greater achievements from you next month.
entries.zh-CN: 恭喜，你为家族作出的贡献超过了所有成员。Duprian Winston 将奖励你的功绩，期待你下个月取得更大成就。

entries.english: Oh! Thanks to your bravery, we were able to crush those good-for-nothing Duprians once again. This is a reward bestowed to you by Vanert Reicht himself for your contributions in battle. I hope to see you in action once again next month.
entries.zh-CN: 多亏你的英勇，我们再次击败了那些无用的 Duprian！这是 Vanert Reicht 亲自赐予的战功奖励，期待你下个月继续奋战。

entries.english: Gens Ranking Reward
entries.zh-CN: 家族排名奖励

entries.english: Gens ranking rewards are given out in the first week of each month.
entries.zh-CN: 家族排名奖励在每月第一周发放。

entries.english: Regrettably, you are not eligible for a reward. Please try harder next time.
entries.zh-CN: 很遗憾，你不符合领奖条件，下次继续努力吧。

entries.english: You do not have enough space for the item. Please free up your Inventory and try again.
entries.zh-CN: 背包空间不足，请整理后再试。

entries.english: The reward has already been handed out.
entries.zh-CN: 奖励已经发放。

entries.english: You have not joined the gens.
entries.zh-CN: 你尚未加入家族。

entries.english: NPC dialog script error!
entries.zh-CN: NPC 对话脚本错误！

entries.english: Select a quest.
entries.zh-CN: 请选择任务。

entries.english: There is no available quest. Please come back later.
entries.zh-CN: 目前没有可接受的任务，请稍后再来。

entries.english: Would you like to visit Chaos Castle, the arena of the gods? There is no better place to prove your strength. Why don't you listen to what I have to say and then decide? (Basic character: Level 15-49, Advanced character: Level 15-29)
entries.zh-CN: 想去诸神的竞技场——赤色要塞吗？那里最适合证明实力。不如先听我介绍，再作决定？（基础职业：15-49级；进阶职业：15-29级）

entries.english: Chaos Castle...
entries.zh-CN: 赤色要塞……

entries.english: Very well. Tell me more.
entries.zh-CN: 好，请继续说。

entries.english: I know it well. I hear you need an item to participate in the event....
entries.zh-CN: 我很了解。听说参加活动需要一件物品……

entries.english: You're well-informed. I will give you the item you need to access Chaos Castle. When you have time, come see me for an easy quest.
entries.zh-CN: 你知道得不少。我可以提供进入赤色要塞所需的物品。有空时来找我，完成一个简单任务即可。

entries.english: A wise decision. Chaos Castle is a battle field created by Lugard, the god of the heaven world, and Secrarium, the god of the underworld, for the balance of good and evil in this world. However, travelers started going to Chaos Castle and fighting on the side of Lugard, tipping the balance in disfavor of Secrarium.
entries.zh-CN: 明智的决定。赤色要塞是天界之神 Lugard 与冥界之神 Secrarium 为维持善恶平衡而设的战场。但冒险者们来到要塞，站在 Lugard 一方战斗，打破了平衡，让 Secrarium 处于劣势。

entries.english: To restore balance to the battle event, Secrarium made Lugard an offer and suggested implementation of a new rule. This rule was for everyone participating in the event to wear guardsman's armor. Lugard, believing the offer to be fair, accepted.
entries.zh-CN: 为恢复战斗的平衡，Secrarium 向 Lugard 提议一条新规则：所有参战者都必须穿上卫兵铠甲。Lugard 认为这很公平，便接受了。

entries.english: I see.
entries.zh-CN: 原来如此。

entries.english: Unfortunately, Secrarium was betting that darkness in the hearts of the travelers would ultimately lead to hostility and discord among them. Lugard was also aware of the travelers' dark side, but his trust in them didn't waver. Ultimately, the travelers did begin to feud with one another like the dark god had anticipated, and Chaos Castle became ever more... chaotic.
entries.zh-CN: 不幸的是，Secrarium 赌的是冒险者内心的阴暗会引发敌意与争斗。Lugard 也知道这一面，却始终信任他们。最终，冒险者果然如冥神所料，开始自相残杀，赤色要塞变得更加混乱。

entries.english: I guess Lugard was tricked by Secrarium. How do I participate?
entries.zh-CN: 看来 Lugard 被 Secrarium 骗了。怎样参加？

entries.english: It's very easy to enter Chaos Castle. Simply right-click on your Armor of Guardsman at the appropriate times (12:00am, 14:00pm, 16:00pm, 18:00pm, 20:00pm, and 22:00pm) to enter. Players in designated locations, such as a PC cafe, will have more opportunities to enter.
entries.zh-CN: 进入赤色要塞很简单，在指定时间（12:00am、14:00pm、16:00pm、18:00pm、20:00pm、22:00pm）右键使用卫兵铠甲即可。在网吧等指定地点游戏的玩家，会有更多入场机会。

entries.english: It really is easy to enter. What does the event involve, exactly?
entries.zh-CN: 入场确实很简单。活动具体怎么玩？

entries.english: You will stand by for about a minute before actually entering. The event starts once this standby time passes. Once it does start, travelers and corrupt guardsmen will fight each other to the death in a no-holds-barred melee.
entries.zh-CN: 入场前需要等待大约一分钟。等待结束后活动开始，冒险者与堕落卫兵展开毫无限制的生死混战。

entries.english: Is there anything I need to be cautious of?
entries.zh-CN: 有什么需要小心的吗？

entries.english: It doesn't matter with the travelers, but you have to be careful when you kill a corrupt guardsman. Corrupt guardsmen will explode and may even push you off the arena. If this happens, you will be disqualified.
entries.zh-CN: 对付冒险者没有特别之处，但击杀堕落卫兵时要小心：他们会爆炸，可能把你推下竞技场，掉下去就会被淘汰。

entries.english: It all makes sense now.
entries.zh-CN: 我都明白了。

entries.english: If you want to find out when you can enter, simply move your mouse over the Armor of Guardsman. If you want to enter, simply right-click on the armor at a designated time. Come see me when you have time, and I will give you a quest that will earn you the item needed to enter the event.
entries.zh-CN: 鼠标移到卫兵铠甲上即可查看入场时间，在指定时间右键使用即可入场。有空来找我，完成任务就能获得参加活动所需的物品。

entries.english: You are back sooner than I thought. I will give you a quest that will earn you the item you need to enter the event. Will you accept this quest? (Basic character: Level 15-49, Advanced character: Level 15-29)
entries.zh-CN: 你回来得比预想的快。我有个任务，完成后可获得参加活动所需的物品。愿意接受吗？（基础职业：15-49级；进阶职业：15-29级）

entries.english: By a 'simple quest', do you mean killing monsters?
entries.zh-CN: 你说的“简单任务”就是打怪吗？

entries.english: Very well. Give me the quest.
entries.zh-CN: 好，把任务交给我吧。

entries.english: I don't have the time right now. I'll do it next time.

entries.zh-CN: 你知道得不少。我可以提供进入赤色要塞所需的物品。有空时来找我，完成一个简单任务即可。

entries.english: A wise decision. Chaos Castle is a battle field created by Lugard, the god of the heaven world, and Secrarium, the god of the underworld, for the balance of good and evil in this world. However, travelers started going to Chaos Castle and fighting on the side of Lugard, tipping the balance in disfavor of Secrarium.
entries.zh-CN: 明智的决定。赤色要塞是天界之神 Lugard 与冥界之神 Secrarium 为维持善恶平衡而设的战场。但冒险者们来到要塞，站在 Lugard 一方战斗，打破了平衡，让 Secrarium 处于劣势。

entries.english: To restore balance to the battle event, Secrarium made Lugard an offer and suggested implementation of a new rule. This rule was for everyone participating in the event to wear guardsman's armor. Lugard, believing the offer to be fair, accepted.
entries.zh-CN: 为恢复战斗的平衡，Secrarium 向 Lugard 提议一条新规则：所有参战者都必须穿上卫兵铠甲。Lugard 认为这很公平，便接受了。

entries.english: I see.
entries.zh-CN: 原来如此。

entries.english: Unfortunately, Secrarium was betting that darkness in the hearts of the travelers would ultimately lead to hostility and discord among them. Lugard was also aware of the travelers' dark side, but his trust in them didn't waver. Ultimately, the travelers did begin to feud with one another like the dark god had anticipated, and Chaos Castle became ever more... chaotic.
entries.zh-CN: 不幸的是，Secrarium 赌的是冒险者内心的阴暗会引发敌意与争斗。Lugard 也知道这一面，却始终信任他们。最终，冒险者果然如冥神所料，开始自相残杀，赤色要塞变得更加混乱。

entries.english: I guess Lugard was tricked by Secrarium. How do I participate?
entries.zh-CN: 看来 Lugard 被 Secrarium 骗了。怎样参加？

entries.english: It's very easy to enter Chaos Castle. Simply right-click on your Armor of Guardsman at the appropriate times (12:00am, 14:00pm, 16:00pm, 18:00pm, 20:00pm, and 22:00pm) to enter. Players in designated locations, such as a PC cafe, will have more opportunities to enter.
entries.zh-CN: 进入赤色要塞很简单，在指定时间（12:00am、14:00pm、16:00pm、18:00pm、20:00pm、22:00pm）右键使用卫兵铠甲即可。在网吧等指定地点游戏的玩家，会有更多入场机会。

entries.english: It really is easy to enter. What does the event involve, exactly?
entries.zh-CN: 入场确实很简单。活动具体怎么玩？

entries.english: You will stand by for about a minute before actually entering. The event starts once this standby time passes. Once it does start, travelers are pitted against 50 corrupt guardsmen in a no-holds-barred melee to the death.
entries.zh-CN: 入场前需要等待大约一分钟。等待结束后，冒险者将与50名堕落卫兵展开毫无限制的生死混战。

entries.english: Is there anything I need to be cautious of?
entries.zh-CN: 有什么需要小心的吗？

entries.english: It doesn't matter with the travelers, but you have to be careful when you kill a corrupt guardsman. Corrupt guardsmen will explode and may even push you off the arena. If this happens, you will be disqualified.
entries.zh-CN: 对付冒险者没有特别之处，但击杀堕落卫兵时要小心：他们会爆炸，可能把你推下竞技场，掉下去就会被淘汰。

entries.english: It all makes sense now.

entries.english: If you want to find out when you can enter, simply move your mouse over the Armor of Guardsman. If you want to enter, simply right-click on the armor at a designated time. Come see me when you have time, and I will give you a quest that will earn you the item needed to enter the event.

entries.english: Have you ever heard of Blood Castle's barrier? Would you like to hear Archangel's request to help defend Blood Castle's barrier and join in the fight for the castle? (Basic character: Level 15-80, Advanced character: Level 10-60)
entries.zh-CN: 听说过血色城堡的结界吗？愿意听听大天使的委托，帮助守护结界，参加城堡之战吗？（基础职业：15-80级；进阶职业：10-60级）

entries.english: Blood Castle...
entries.zh-CN: 血色城堡……

entries.english: Very well. Tell me more.
entries.zh-CN: 好，请继续说。

entries.english: I know it well. I hear you need a special item to go there....
entries.zh-CN: 我很了解。听说去那里需要一件特殊物品……

entries.english: You're well-informed. In order to penetrate the barrier surrounding Blood Castle, you will need an Invisibility Cloak. If you pass a simple test of mine, I will provide you with an Invisibility Cloak before you head to Blood Castle. When you have time, come see me for an easy quest.
entries.zh-CN: 你知道得不少。穿过血色城堡的结界需要透明披风。通过我的简单测试，出发前我会给你一件。有空来找我接受任务吧。

entries.english: I will tell you then. Devildom's royal guards, who were summoned when Kundun succumbed to Secrarium, posed a great threat to the heaven world. To protect their base, the Twelve Saints formed a barrier around Blood Castle.
entries.zh-CN: 我来讲给你听。昆顿屈从于 Secrarium 后，召来的魔界禁卫军严重威胁天界。为了保卫据点，十二圣者在血色城堡周围设下结界。

entries.english: Kundun, however, must've anticipated such a move. He hid beyond the range of the barrier and eliminated the Twelve Saints as soon as the barrier was formed. Luckily, Archangel evaded that peril and sacrificed himself for the barrier.
entries.zh-CN: 昆顿似乎早有预料，他躲在结界范围之外，在结界完成时杀害了十二圣者。幸好大天使逃过一劫，并为结界献出了自己。

entries.english: Kundun's Royal Guards, however, continue to attack the barrier, and are weakening it. We need Archangel's weapon in order to prevent this weakening of the barrier, and that's why we are now seeking the help of travelers.
entries.zh-CN: 昆顿的禁卫军仍在攻击并削弱结界。要阻止结界衰弱，就需要大天使的武器，因此我们正在寻求冒险者的帮助。

entries.english: I see. How do I enter?
entries.zh-CN: 明白了。怎样入场？

entries.english: It's very easy to enter Blood Castle. The battle event takes place every two hours from 12:30am and on. To enter, take an Invisibility Cloak that's right for your level to the Messenger of Archangel in Devias, five minutes before a Blood Castle event commences and ask to join. The Messenger of Archangel will then send you to the castle.
entries.zh-CN: 进入血色城堡很简单。活动从12:30am起，每隔两小时开放一次。开始前五分钟，携带适合自身等级的透明披风，到冰风谷找大天使的使者申请参加，他会将你送入城堡。

entries.english: It really is easy to enter. What does the event involve, exactly?
entries.zh-CN: 入场确实很简单。活动具体怎么玩？

entries.english: You will stand by for about a minute before actually entering. You'll enter Blood Castle after this standby time has elapsed. Once inside Blood Castle, you can buy some time by defeating 40 monsters summoned by a necromancer named Red Skull.
entries.zh-CN: 入场前需要等待大约一分钟。等待结束后进入血色城堡，击败死灵法师 Red Skull 召唤的40只怪物，可以为行动争取时间。

entries.english: Go past the castle gate and defeat two Red Skulls who have hidden the Absolute Weapon. This will buy you some more time and reveal a casket containing the weapon. Destroy the casket, defeat more monsters, and return the Absolute Weapon to Archangel to successfully complete the Blood Castle quest.
entries.zh-CN: 攻破城门，击败藏起绝对武器的两名 Red Skull，可争取更多时间，并使装有武器的棺匣出现。摧毁棺匣、继续击杀怪物，将绝对武器交还大天使，即可完成血色城堡任务。

entries.english: I understand.
entries.zh-CN: 明白了。

entries.english: To find out when you can enter, simply press the F1 key. If you want to enter, take an Invisibility Cloak that's right for your level to the Messenger of Archangel before the scheduled start time. Come see me when you have time, and I will give you a quest that will earn you the Invisibility Cloak so that you can enter Blood Castle.
entries.zh-CN: 按 F1 可查看入场时间。活动开始前，携带适合自身等级的透明披风，找大天使的使者申请入场。有空来找我，完成任务就能获得进入血色城堡所需的透明披风。

entries.english: You're back sooner than I thought. I have a quest that will earn you an item you'll need to enter Blood Castle. Will you accept this quest? (Basic character: Level 15-80, Advanced character: Level 10-60)
entries.zh-CN: 你回来得比预想的快。我有个任务，可让你获得进入血色城堡所需的物品。愿意接受吗？（基础职业：15-80级；进阶职业：10-60级）

entries.english: By a 'simple quest', do you mean killing monsters?
entries.zh-CN: 你说的“简单任务”就是打怪吗？

entries.english: Very well. Give me the quest.
entries.zh-CN: 好，把任务交给我吧。

entries.english: I don't have the time right now. I'll do it next time.
entries.zh-CN: 现在没时间，下次再做吧。

entries.english: That's unfortunate. Please come back if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 真遗憾，改变主意后再来找我吧。（任务已取消）

entries.english: Very well. It appears Hell Hounds are causing quite a headache for novice travelers to the Dungeon these days. Hunt down 40 Hell Hounds, and I'll give you an Invisibility Cloak + 1 as a reward. At your current level, it'll be too dangerous for you to hunt the monsters alone. It'll be better if you hunt in a party.
entries.zh-CN: 地下城的地狱猎犬怪最近让新手冒险者很头疼。消灭40只地狱猎犬怪，我会奖励透明披风+1。以你目前的等级，单独狩猎太危险，建议组队前往。

entries.english: In Blood Castle, you'll be fighting against time. Good armor and weapons will, of course, help you complete your quest. But more than anything else, solidarity of your party is what will count there. Will you accept Archangel's quest? (Basic character: Level 15-80, Advanced character: Level 10-60)
entries.zh-CN: 在血色城堡，你必须争分夺秒。好装备固然有帮助，但最重要的是队伍团结。愿意接受大天使的委托吗？（基础职业：15-80级；进阶职业：10-60级）

entries.english: Of course. I gladly accept Archangel's quest.
entries.zh-CN: 当然，我很乐意接受大天使的委托。

entries.english: I neither have the skills nor the warriors I need to take on this quest. Give me more time.
entries.zh-CN: 我的实力和队友都还没准备好，再给我些时间。

entries.english: That's unfortunate. Come see me again when you find the right warriors to fight at your side. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 真遗憾，找到合适的战友后再来吧。（任务已取消）

entries.english: A wise decision. Try your hand at Blood Castle Level 1. Destroy the castle gate at least, and I'll give you 100,000 Zens as a reward. However, this applies only to Blood Castle Level 1.
entries.zh-CN: 明智的决定。挑战血色城堡1层，至少攻破城门，我会奖励100,000金币。仅限血色城堡1层。

entries.english: It seems you have mighty warriors who are willing to fight at your side. Facing the challenges of Blood Castle together will certainly strengthen your bond with your comrades. Will you return to Blood Castle and carry out another quest of Archangel? (Basic character: Level 15-80, Advanced character: Level 10-60)
entries.zh-CN: 看来你已有强大的战友。一起挑战血色城堡，定能加深彼此的情谊。愿意再次前往，完成大天使的委托吗？（基础职业：15-80级；进阶职业：10-60级）

entries.english: Of course. I gladly accept Archangel's quest.
entries.zh-CN: 当然，我很乐意接受大天使的委托。

entries.english: The bond between my comrades and I isn't strong enough yet.
entries.zh-CN: 我和队友之间的情谊还不够深。

entries.english: That's unfortunate. Come see me again when the bond between you and your comrades is stronger. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 真遗憾，等你们的情谊更加深厚后再来吧。（任务已取消）

entries.english: Try your hand at Blood Castle Level 1 and complete Archangel's quest. Come back afterwards, and I'll give you 100,000 EXP points and 200,000 Zens as a reward. However, this applies only to Blood Castle Level 1.
entries.zh-CN: 挑战血色城堡1层并完成大天使的委托，回来可获得100,000经验和200,000金币。仅限血色城堡1层。

entries.english: The bond of fellowship.... Of course comrades should be trusted and valued.
entries.zh-CN: 战友情谊……当然应该信任并珍惜同伴。
