entries.english: Are you familiar with a hidden training ground known as Devil Square? It's an opportune place to develop your skills. Why don't you listen to what I have to say and then decide? (Basic character: Level 15-130, Advanced character: Level 10-110)
entries.zh-CN: 知道名为恶魔广场的隐秘修炼场吗？那里很适合磨炼技艺。不如先听我介绍，再作决定？（基础职业：15-130级；进阶职业：10-110级）

entries.english: Devil Square...
entries.zh-CN: 恶魔广场……

entries.english: Very well. Tell me more.
entries.zh-CN: 好，请继续说。

entries.english: I already knew that.
entries.zh-CN: 这个我已经知道了。

entries.english: You're well-informed. I'll give you the item you'll need to enter Devil Square. When you have time, come see me for an easy quest.
entries.zh-CN: 你知道得不少。我可以提供进入恶魔广场所需的物品，有空时来找我完成一个简单任务即可。

entries.english: Devil Square is the place where the Elf Tree once stood. The Elf Tree was created by the mother of all Elves, an underground Elf known as Aria. This tree had the ability to produce Elves regularly. Then Secrarium tricked Lugard and appeared in Noria, at the location of the Elf Tree.
entries.zh-CN: 恶魔广场曾是精灵之树所在之地。所有精灵的母亲、地下精灵 Aria 创造了这棵树，它能定期孕育精灵。后来 Secrarium 欺骗了 Lugard，来到仙踪林的精灵之树旁。

entries.english: Having set his eyes on the tree's power of birth, Secrarium corrupted the Elf Tree and transformed it into an Immoral Tree that gave birth to monsters.  The monsters horde grew to astronomical proportions, and the kingdoms of the MU continent combined their forces to entrap the immoral tree in a space of nothingness.
entries.zh-CN: Secrarium 看中了树的孕育之力，将它腐化为诞生怪物的邪恶之树。怪物数量急剧增长，奇迹大陆各国联合起来，将邪恶之树封入虚无空间。

entries.english: Monsters, however, continued to spawn at regular intervals from the spot where the tree once stood. After careful consideration, the queen of the Elves decided to make a training arena of this place for travelers.
entries.zh-CN: 然而，树原先所在之处仍定期出现怪物。精灵女王深思熟虑后，决定将此地改为冒险者的修炼场。

entries.english: I see. How do I enter?
entries.zh-CN: 明白了。怎样入场？

entries.english: It's very easy to enter Devil Square. It can be entered every four hours from 3:00 a.m. and on (3:00 a.m., 7:00 a.m., 11:00 a.m., 3:00 p.m., 7:00 p.m., and 11:00 p.m.). To enter, take a Devil's Invitation that's right for your level to Charon in Noria five minutes before a scheduled entry time and ask to join. Charon will then send you to Devil Square.
entries.zh-CN: 恶魔广场从3:00 a.m.起每四小时开放一次（3:00 a.m.、7:00 a.m.、11:00 a.m.、3:00 p.m.、7:00 p.m.、11:00 p.m.）。入场前五分钟，携带适合等级的恶魔广场通行证，向仙踪林的卡隆申请，他会将你送入广场。

entries.english: It really is easy to enter. What does the event involve, exactly?
entries.zh-CN: 入场确实很简单。活动具体怎么玩？

entries.english: You'll stand by for about a minute before actually entering. Once this standby time passes, monsters will start to appear. The monsters will continue to attack for ten minutes, and killing them will earn you points. If you score high enough, you might even receive a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 入场前需要等待大约一分钟。等待结束后怪物开始出现，持续进攻十分钟。击杀怪物可以积分，分数足够高还有机会获得奖励。

entries.english: Is there anything I should know about Devil Square?
entries.zh-CN: 恶魔广场有什么需要注意的？

entries.english: You'll face a steady stream of powerful monsters at Devil Square. Forming a party with other travelers before entering will give you a better chance of survival.
entries.zh-CN: 恶魔广场的强敌会不断出现。入场前与其他冒险者组队，能提高生存机会。

entries.english: It all makes sense now.
entries.zh-CN: 我都明白了。

entries.english: To find out when you can enter, press the F1 key. Then, take a Devil's Invitation that's right for your level to Charon in Noria five minutes before the entry time you've chosen. You'll be sent to Devil Square. Come see me when you have time, and I'll give you a quest that will earn you the item you need to enter Devil Square.
entries.zh-CN: 按 F1 查看入场时间。提前五分钟，携带适合等级的恶魔广场通行证，找仙踪林的卡隆进入广场。有空来找我，完成任务就能获得入场物品。

entries.english: You are back sooner than I thought. I have a simple quest that will earn you an invitation granting you access to Devil Square. Will you accept this quest? (Basic character: Level 15-130, Advanced character: Level 10-110)
entries.zh-CN: 你回来得比预想的快。我有个简单任务，完成后可获得恶魔广场通行证。愿意接受吗？（基础职业：15-130级；进阶职业：10-110级）

entries.english: By a 'simple quest', do you mean killing monsters?
entries.zh-CN: 你说的“简单任务”就是打怪吗？

entries.english: Very well. Give me the quest.
entries.zh-CN: 好，把任务交给我吧。

entries.english: I don't have the time right now. I'll do it next time.
entries.zh-CN: 现在没时间，下次再做吧。

entries.english: That's unfortunate. Please come back if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 真遗憾，改变主意后再来找我吧。（任务已取消）

entries.english: It seems Cursed Liches are tormenting the residents of Elveland with their dark spells and curses. Hunt down 40 of those Cursed Liches, and I'll give you a Devil's Invitation +1 as a reward. I suggest you work with others for faster results.

entries.english: Are you familiar with a hidden training ground known as Devil Square? It's an opportune place to develop your skills. Why don't you listen to what I have to say and then decide? (Basic character: Level 131-180, Advanced character: Level 111-160)
entries.zh-CN: 知道名为恶魔广场的隐秘修炼场吗？那里很适合磨炼技艺。不如先听我介绍，再作决定？（基础职业：131-180级；进阶职业：111-160级）

entries.english: Devil Square...
entries.zh-CN: 恶魔广场……

entries.english: Very well. Tell me more.
entries.zh-CN: 好，请继续说。

entries.english: I already knew that.
entries.zh-CN: 这个我已经知道了。

entries.english: You're well-informed. I'll give you the item you'll need to enter Devil Square. When you have time, come see me for an easy quest.
entries.zh-CN: 你知道得不少。我可以提供进入恶魔广场所需的物品，有空时来找我完成一个简单任务即可。

entries.english: Devil Square is the place where the Elf Tree once stood. The Elf Tree was created by the mother of all Elves, an underground Elf known as Aria. This tree had the ability to produce Elves regularly. Then Secrarium tricked Lugard and appeared in Noria, at the location of the Elf Tree.
entries.zh-CN: 恶魔广场曾是精灵之树所在之地。所有精灵的母亲、地下精灵 Aria 创造了这棵树，它能定期孕育精灵。后来 Secrarium 欺骗了 Lugard，来到仙踪林的精灵之树旁。

entries.english: Having set his eyes on the tree's power of birth, Secrarium corrupted the Elf Tree and transformed it into an Immoral Tree that gave birth to monsters.  The monsters horde grew to astronomical proportions, and the kingdoms of the MU continent combined their forces to entrap the immoral tree in a space of nothingness.
entries.zh-CN: Secrarium 看中了树的孕育之力，将它腐化为诞生怪物的邪恶之树。怪物数量急剧增长，奇迹大陆各国联合起来，将邪恶之树封入虚无空间。

entries.english: Monsters, however, continued to spawn at regular intervals from the spot where the tree once stood. After careful consideration, the queen of the Elves decided to make a training arena of this place for travelers.
entries.zh-CN: 然而，树原先所在之处仍定期出现怪物。精灵女王深思熟虑后，决定将此地改为冒险者的修炼场。

entries.english: I see. How do I enter?
entries.zh-CN: 明白了。怎样入场？

entries.english: It's very easy to enter Devil Square. It can be entered every four hours from 3:00 a.m. and on (3:00 a.m., 7:00 a.m., 11:00 a.m., 3:00 p.m., 7:00 p.m., and 11:00 p.m.). To enter, take a Devil's Invitation that's right for your level to Charon in Noria five minutes before a scheduled entry time and ask to join. Charon will then send you to Devil Square.
entries.zh-CN: 恶魔广场从3:00 a.m.起每四小时开放一次（3:00 a.m.、7:00 a.m.、11:00 a.m.、3:00 p.m.、7:00 p.m.、11:00 p.m.）。入场前五分钟，携带适合等级的恶魔广场通行证，向仙踪林的卡隆申请，他会将你送入广场。

entries.english: It really is easy to enter. What does the event involve, exactly?
entries.zh-CN: 入场确实很简单。活动具体怎么玩？

entries.english: You'll stand by for about a minute before actually entering. Once this standby time passes, monsters will start to appear. The monsters will continue to attack for ten minutes, and killing them will earn you points. If you score high enough, you might even receive a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 入场前需要等待大约一分钟。等待结束后怪物开始出现，持续进攻十分钟。击杀怪物可以积分，分数足够高还有机会获得奖励。

entries.english: Is there anything I should know about Devil Square?
entries.zh-CN: 恶魔广场有什么需要注意的？

entries.english: You'll face a steady stream of powerful monsters at Devil Square. Forming a party with other travelers before entering will give you a better chance of survival.
entries.zh-CN: 恶魔广场的强敌会不断出现。入场前与其他冒险者组队，能提高生存机会。

entries.english: It all makes sense now.
entries.zh-CN: 我都明白了。

entries.english: To find out when you can enter, press the F1 key. Then, take a Devil's Invitation that's right for your level to Charon in Noria five minutes before the entry time you've chosen. You'll be sent to Devil Square. Come see me when you have time, and I'll give you a quest that will earn you the item you need to enter Devil Square.
entries.zh-CN: 按 F1 查看入场时间。提前五分钟，携带适合等级的恶魔广场通行证，找仙踪林的卡隆进入广场。有空来找我，完成任务就能获得入场物品。

entries.english: You are back sooner than I thought. I have a simple quest that will earn you an invitation granting you access to Devil Square. Will you accept this quest? (Basic character: Level 131-180, Advanced character: Level 111-160)

entries.english: Devil Square is a place where you can develop your abilities quickly. Prepare thoroughly before entering as this is not a place to be taken lightly. Go to the Shadow Phantom Soldier and accept the quest to earn a Devil's Invitation, which you'll need to enter Devil Square.
entries.zh-CN: 恶魔广场可助你快速成长，但不可轻视，入场前务必准备充分。向幻影导师接受任务，获取所需通行证。

entries.english: Go to the Swamp of Peace. Defeat 140 Shadow Knights and return to the Shadow Phantom Soldier to receive a Devil's Invitation + 7, which you will need to enter Devil Square.
entries.zh-CN: 前往安宁池，消灭140只 Shadow Knight，再找幻影导师领取恶魔广场通行证+7。

entries.english: The Shadow Phantom Soldier will give you a small reward if you manage fast growth at Devil Square. Accept the Shadow Phantom Soldier's test and take the Devil Square challenge.
entries.zh-CN: 在恶魔广场快速成长，可得到幻影导师的小奖励。接受他的测试，前往挑战吧。

entries.english: Try your hand at Devil Square Level 7. Defeat the monsters and score 240 points to receive a reward from the Shadow Phantom Soldier. However, this applies only to Devil Square Level 7.

entries.english: Have you ever heard of Illusion Temple and the ancient relics hidden there? It's a place where travelers can find both wealth and fame. Why don't you listen to what I have to say and then decide? (All characters: Level 220-270)
entries.zh-CN: 听说过幻影寺院及其中的古代圣物吗？冒险者在那里能获得财富与声望。不如先听我介绍，再作决定？（所有职业：220-270级）

entries.english: Illusion Temple...
entries.zh-CN: 幻影寺院……

entries.english: Very well. Tell me more.
entries.zh-CN: 好，请继续说。

entries.english: I already knew that.
entries.zh-CN: 这个我已经知道了。

entries.english: You're well-informed. I'm in charge of distributing items that are necessary to enter Illusion Temple. When you have time, come see me for an easy quest that will earn you a ticket in.
entries.zh-CN: 你知道得不少。我负责发放进入幻影寺院所需的物品。有空来找我完成简单任务，即可获得入场凭证。

entries.english: Illusion Spells, the foundation of Illusion Sorcery, was discovered by an Archaeologist named Mirage. Mirage found the spells' power to be too dangerous and sealed it. His partner Lev, however, stole the spells to brainwash people and establish Illusion Sorcery. Illusion Sorcery gradually grew larger and brought chaos to the continent.
entries.zh-CN: 考古学家弥拉邱发现了幻影魔法的基础——幻影咒文。他认为力量太危险，便将其封印。同伴 Lev 却盗走咒文，用它洗脑他人，建立幻影教团。教团日益壮大，为大陆带来混乱。

entries.english: Grand Wizard Etramu vowed to destroy Illusion Sorcery and formed an army to subjugate its followers. Under Etramu's command, the alliance engaged the followers of Illusion Sorcery with formidable force. Despite having been driven all the way back to Illusion Temple, the followers continued to resist. As battle raged on, Lev disappeared and left the followers of Illusion Sorcery in confusion. Ultimately, they all met their death at the hands of the alliance on the temple grounds.
entries.zh-CN: 大魔法师 Etramu 誓要消灭幻影教团，集结军队讨伐。在他的指挥下，联军强势进攻，教徒退守幻影寺院后仍顽抗。战斗中 Lev 突然消失，教徒陷入混乱，最终全被联军消灭在寺院中。

entries.english: Due to Lev's illusion spells, however, the souls of the dead followers remained in this world to defend the temple. These souls believed Lev's return would allow them to reclaim their bodies and continued to safeguard the temple. Today, the temple is guarded by the alliance in case Lev does actually return and Illusion Sorcery uses ancient relics to lure in unsuspecting travelers to their cause.
entries.zh-CN: 受 Lev 的幻影咒文影响，死去教徒的灵魂仍留在人间守护寺院。他们相信 Lev 回来便能使自己复生。如今联军守卫着寺院，防备 Lev 回归；教团则用古代圣物诱惑毫不知情的冒险者。

entries.english: I see. How do I enter?
entries.zh-CN: 明白了。怎样入场？

entries.english: It's very easy to enter Illusion Temple. It can be entered every four hours from 01:00 a.m. and on: 01:00 a.m., 05:00 a.m., 09:00 a.m., 01:00 p.m., 05:00 p.m., and 09:00 p.m. To enter, take a Scroll of Blood that's right for your level to Mirage in Elveland five minutes before an Illusion Temple event commences and ask to join. Mirage will then send you to the temple.
entries.zh-CN: 幻影寺院从01:00 a.m.起每四小时开放一次：01:00 a.m.、05:00 a.m.、09:00 a.m.、01:00 p.m.、05:00 p.m.、09:00 p.m.。开始前五分钟，带上适合等级的血色卷轴，到幻术园找弥拉邱申请入场。

entries.english: It really is easy to enter. What does the event involve, exactly?
entries.zh-CN: 入场确实很简单。活动具体怎么玩？

entries.english: Upon entering, you'll need to wait for other players to enter. The players will then be divided into two teams: Alliance Camp and Illusion Sorcery Camp. The camp that brings over more relics to their own side wins.
entries.zh-CN: 入场后需等待其他玩家，随后分成联军和幻影教团两个阵营。运回己方的圣物更多的一方获胜。

entries.english: Is there anything I should be aware of about Illusion Temple?
entries.zh-CN: 幻影寺院有什么需要注意的？

entries.english: You'll not be able to use certain skills like Teleport or Telekinesis while holding on to a relic. On the other hand, there are special skills that can only be used in Illusion Temple. Using these skills to your advantage will make it easier for your camp to win.
entries.zh-CN: 携带圣物时，无法使用瞬间移动、念力等部分技能。此外，寺院中有专用技能，善加利用可帮助己方获胜。

entries.english: It all makes sense now.
entries.zh-CN: 我都明白了。

entries.english: To find out when you can enter, press the F1 key. Then, take a Scroll of Blood that's right for your level to Mirage in Elveland five minutes before the entry time you've chosen. You'll then be sent to Illusion Temple. Come see me when you have time, and I'll give you a quest that will earn you the item needed to enter Illusion Temple.
entries.zh-CN: 按 F1 查看入场时间。提前五分钟，携带适合等级的血色卷轴，找幻术园的弥拉邱进入寺院。有空来找我，完成任务就能获得入场物品。

entries.english: You are back sooner than I thought. I have a simple quest that will earn you a Scroll of Blood, which will grant you access to Illusion Temple. Will you accept? (All characters: Level 220-270)
entries.zh-CN: 你回来得比预想的快。我有个简单任务，可让你获得进入幻影寺院所需的血色卷轴。愿意接受吗？（所有职业：220-270级）

entries.english: By a 'simple quest', do you mean killing monsters?
entries.zh-CN: 你说的“简单任务”就是打怪吗？

entries.english: Very well. Give me the quest.
entries.zh-CN: 好，把任务交给我吧。

entries.english: I don't have the time right now. I'll do it next time.
entries.zh-CN: 现在没时间，下次再做吧。

entries.english: That's unfortunate. Please come back if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 真遗憾，改变主意后再来找我吧。（任务已取消）

entries.english: The increasing number of Bloody Wolves in Tarkan is becoming worrisome. Hunt down 50 Bloody Wolves, and I'll give you a Scroll of Blood + 1 as a reward.
entries.zh-CN: 死亡沙漠的巨齿怪数量激增，令人担忧。消灭50只巨齿怪，我会奖励血色卷轴+1。

entries.english: You can find both wealth and fame at Illusion Temple. If you take the temple challenge, you might acquire something essential for your training. Would you like to take the challenge? (All characters: Level 220-270)
entries.zh-CN: 幻影寺院能带来财富与声望。接受挑战，或许能得到修炼所需的重要物品。愿意尝试吗？（所有职业：220-270级）

entries.english: Very well. I will take on this challenge.

entries.zh-CN: 挑战幻影寺院1层并获胜，可获得1颗灵魂宝石。仅限幻影寺院1层。

entries.english: I trust you are somewhat familiar with Illusion Temple by now. You'll now be moved to a place where even more powerful monsters spawn. There's no need to worry, however. You can expect rapid growth as long as you and your comrades learn to work together.

entries.english: There are a number of ways you can prove your worth on the continent of MU. You can try to be the last one standing in Chaos Castle, or work with your comrades to battle through Blood Castle, Devil Square, or Illusion Temple. Travelers regard such feats as some of the worthiest accomplishments one can achieve.
entries.zh-CN: 在奇迹大陆，证明自己的方式很多：成为赤色要塞最后的幸存者，或与战友并肩闯过血色城堡、恶魔广场和幻影寺院。冒险者们将这些视为最值得骄傲的成就。

entries.english: So it's not just about equipment or level.
entries.zh-CN: 原来不只看装备和等级。

entries.english: That's right. You do need good equipment and a high level to test your mettle against other travelers, yes. But just that isn't enough for you to become a hero of MU. I will help you receive recognition as a hero by giving you a series of missions. You may repeat these missions as often as desired.
entries.zh-CN: 没错，与其他冒险者较量，确实需要好装备和高等级，但仅凭这些不足以成为奇迹英雄。我会给你一系列任务，助你赢得英雄的认可。这些任务可以反复挑战。

entries.english: Recognition as a hero...
entries.zh-CN: 得到英雄的认可……

entries.english: To start off, I'll give you a simple mission to see if you have the right qualities to be a hero. Will you accept this mission? (Basic character: Level 240 - 270, Advanced character: Level 220 - 260)
entries.zh-CN: 先给你一个简单任务，看看你是否具备英雄的资质。愿意接受吗？（基础职业：240-270级；进阶职业：220-260级）

entries.english: Sure! What's this simple mission about? (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 当然！是什么简单任务？（接受）

entries.english: I don't need to be judged like this! (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 我不需要这种评判！（拒绝）

entries.english: I'm sorry to hear that. There are many ways to become stronger, but they'll all take time. Remember that well.
entries.zh-CN: 真遗憾。变强的方法很多，但都需要时间，请记住这一点。

entries.english: You have accepted the first trial. I want you to prove your combat prowess by defeating 5 Guardsmen in Chaos Castle, delivering Archangel's weapon in Blood Castle, and surviving till the end in Devil Square. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with either a Jewel of Bless, a Jewel of Soul, or a Jewel of Chaos.
entries.zh-CN: 你已接受第一项试炼。请在赤色要塞击败5名卫兵，在血色城堡交还大天使武器，并在恶魔广场坚持到最后，以证明战斗能力。完成后可获得祝福宝石、灵魂宝石或玛雅之石中的一种奖励。

entries.english: Congratulations. You have completed the first mission. Then I will give you the second mission right away. Will you accept this mission? (Basic character: Level 240 - 270, Advanced character: Level 220 - 260)
entries.zh-CN: 恭喜完成第一个任务，我马上给你第二个。愿意接受吗？（基础职业：240-270级；进阶职业：220-260级）

entries.english: I accept the mission. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 我接受任务。（接受）

entries.english: No, I need some rest first. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 不，我需要先休息。（拒绝）

entries.english: I'm sorry to hear that. You can't repeat the first mission if you abandon the second mission. You must complete the second mission before you can repeat the first mission. Please return if you change your mind.
entries.zh-CN: 真遗憾。放弃第二个任务后，不能直接重做第一个。必须先完成第二个任务，才能再次挑战第一个。改变主意后再来吧。

entries.english: Good decision. This mission requires you to raise your worth by claiming victory in Illusion Temple. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with 800,000 Exp.
entries.zh-CN: 明智的决定。这次请在幻影寺院获胜，以提升自己的价值。完成后可获得800,000经验。

entries.english: You have completed the first trial to become a hero. The next mission I'll give you is to see if you have the courage to be a hero. Will you accept this mission? (Basic character: Level 300 - 320, Advanced character: Level 271 - 320)
entries.zh-CN: 你已完成成为英雄的第一项试炼。下一项将考验英雄应有的勇气。愿意接受吗？（基础职业：300-320级；进阶职业：271-320级）

entries.english: I accept the mission. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 我接受任务。（接受）

entries.english: I think I have enough courage already. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 我觉得自己已经很勇敢了。（拒绝）

entries.english: Courage is the most important trait for a hero. If you lack the proper courage, you can never be reborn as a hero.
entries.zh-CN: 勇气是英雄最重要的品质。缺乏勇气，就永远无法成为真正的英雄。

entries.english: Good decision. The first mission for the second trial involves defeating 10 Guardsmen in Chaos Castle, delivering Archangel's weapon in Blood Castle, and surviving until the end of Devil Square. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with either a Jewel of Bless, a Jewel of Soul, a Jewel of Chaos, or a Jewel of Harmony.
entries.zh-CN: 明智的决定。第二项试炼的首个任务：在赤色要塞击败10名卫兵，在血色城堡交还大天使武器，并在恶魔广场坚持到最后。完成后可获得祝福宝石、灵魂宝石、玛雅之石或再生宝石中的一种奖励。

entries.zh-CN: 我接受任务。（接受）

entries.english: No, I need some rest first. (Refuse)

entries.english: I'm sorry to hear that. You can't repeat the first mission if you abandon the second mission. You must complete the second mission before you can repeat the first mission. Please return if you change your mind.
entries.zh-CN: 真遗憾。放弃第二个任务后，不能直接重做第一个。必须先完成第二个任务，才能再次挑战第一个。改变主意后再来吧。

entries.english: Then I will give you the second mission right away. Show no fear against a number of foes at once, and attain victory in Illusion Temple. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with 3,000,000 Exp.
entries.zh-CN: 现在给你第二个任务。面对众多敌人也不要畏惧，在幻影寺院取得胜利。完成后可获得3,000,000经验。

entries.english: You have now completed the second trial to become a hero. The next mission I'll give you is to see if you have the fighting spirit to be a hero. Will you accept this mission? (Level 331 - 350)
entries.zh-CN: 你已完成成为英雄的第二项试炼。下一项将考验英雄应有的斗志。愿意接受吗？（331-350级）

entries.english: It's fighting spirit this time? I accept the mission. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 这次考验斗志？我接受。（接受）

entries.english: A fighting spirit doesn't benefit a hero. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 斗志对英雄没什么用。（拒绝）

entries.english: I hope you realize that a hero without a fighting spirit is merely a coward.
entries.zh-CN: 希望你明白，没有斗志的英雄不过是个懦夫。

entries.english: You've made a wise choice. The first mission for the third trial involves defeating 20 Guardsmen in Chaos Castle, delivering Archangel's weapon in Blood Castle, and surviving until the end of Devil Square. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with either a Jewel of Bless, a Jewel of Life, a Jewel of Harmony, or two Jewels of Soul.

entries.english: Then I will give you the second mission right away. Shock your rivals out of their senses by attaining a victory in Illusion Temple. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with 5,000,000 Exp.
entries.zh-CN: 现在给你第二个任务。在幻影寺院取得胜利，令对手震惊。完成后可获得5,000,000经验。

entries.english: You have now completed the third trial to become a hero. The next mission I'll give you is to see if you have the right mentality to be a hero. Will you accept this mission? (Level 351 - 380)
entries.zh-CN: 你已完成成为英雄的第三项试炼。下一项将考验英雄应有的心志。愿意接受吗？（351-380级）

entries.english: I'll stay focused until the very end! (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 我会专注到最后！（接受）

entries.english: I have no time right now. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 现在没时间。（拒绝）

entries.english: A hero without strong mind is little better than a corpse. Please continue challenging yourself until the end.
entries.zh-CN: 意志薄弱的英雄与行尸走肉无异。请坚持挑战，直到最后。

管理仓库可不容易。守卫的薪酬、各城镇之间的空间传送，还有数不清的废弃仓库……我们需要新仓库！为此，我想到了一个好办法。
什么办法？
把古董卖给富人，筹一笔资金。冒险者眼中不起眼的石头，在他们眼里却有艺术价值。富人真是……不过也多亏他们，我才能赚钱。你若愿意帮忙，我就让你使用新仓库。
我该怎样帮你？
帮我带来古代雕像，我就在新仓库里多分给你一个空间，如何？（角色等级50以上）
我明白了。（接受）
我现在很忙，无法帮你。（拒绝）
真可惜。如果想扩充仓库，随时回来找我。（任务已取消。）
失落之塔7层的死神骑士身上有古代雕像。把它带来，我就给你一个新仓库。重新登录后才能使用。
你知道平时的背包是用什么做的吗？是魔法布料，所以冒险者才能带着许多沉重的装备。虽然人手一个，布料其实非常珍贵。我想和你做笔交易……
什么交易？
有了魔法布料，背包就能装下更多东西。把魔法布料交给我，我会用剩下的布料帮你扩充背包，让你携带更多物品。
你愿意帮我带来魔法布料吗？（角色等级150以上）
我明白了。（接受）
我现在很忙，无法帮你。（拒绝）
真遗憾。改变主意的话，随时回来找我。（任务已取消。）
亚特兰蒂斯3层的银弓海怪身上有魔法布料。虽然不容易得到，但为了更大的背包，这番辛苦值得。请把魔法布料带来，重新登录后即可查看扩充后的背包。
你有什么事？
还能继续扩充魔法背包吗？
你想要更大的魔法背包？虽然不容易，但也有办法。有位魔法师说，可以用空间布料利用那些闲置空间。
你能帮我找来空间布料吗？（角色等级300以上）
我明白了。（接受）
我现在很忙，无法帮你。（拒绝）
真可惜。如果想扩充仓库，随时回来找我。（任务已取消。）
天空之城1层的阿卡摩斯身上有空间布料。把它带来，我就帮你继续扩充魔法背包。重新登录后即可查看。
想扩充仓库，请找流浪商人Zyro。
消灭失落之塔7层的死神骑士，取得古代雕像并交给流浪商人Zyro，即可扩充仓库。
想进行第1次背包扩充，请找流浪商人Zyro。
消灭亚特兰蒂斯的银弓海怪，取得魔法布料并交给流浪商人Zyro，即可进行第1次背包扩充。重新登录后即可查看。
想进行第2次背包扩充，请找流浪商人Zyro。
消灭天空之城的阿卡摩斯，取得空间布料并交给流浪商人Zyro，即可进行第2次背包扩充。重新登录后即可查看。

entries.english: A wise decision. Defeat 50 Cursed Liches in Elveland (Area 2) and 50 Yetis in Devias (Area 2). Do that, and you'll receive 60,000 EXP points, 1,500,000 Zens, and 1 Jewel of Chaos as a reward from the Shadow Phantom Soldier.
entries.zh-CN: 明智的决定。消灭50只诅咒巫妖（幻术园区域2），以及50只雪人（冰风谷区域2），然后找幻影导师领取60,000经验、1,500,000金币和1颗玛雅之石。

entries.english: You'll now find it increasingly difficult to find suitable hunting ground. How about discovering hunting grounds by accepting quests from Shadow Phantom Soldiers? Come see me when you reach a new level to receive quests that will earn you prized equipment.
entries.zh-CN: 今后，寻找合适的练级地点会越来越难。不妨通过幻影导师的任务探索练级地点。达到新等级后就来找我，完成任务可获得珍贵装备。

entries.english: Earn valuable equipment by completing simple quests?
entries.zh-CN: 完成简单任务就能获得珍贵装备？

entries.english: I can't pass up on this. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 这个机会不能错过。（接受）

entries.english: I'm sorry. I don't have the time right now. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 抱歉，我现在没时间。（拒绝）

entries.english: I need you to accept a small quest first as a test. Are you up to it? There is of course a reasonable reward for finishing.
entries.zh-CN: 先完成一个小任务，考验一下你的实力。你愿意吗？完成后当然会有相应的奖励。

entries.english: Hmm... that doesn't sound all that bad.
entries.zh-CN: 嗯……听起来不错。

entries.english: Let me give it a go. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 让我试试。（接受）

entries.english: A wise decision. Defeat 50 Totem Golems in Elveland (Area 3) and 50 Elite Yetis in Devias (Area 3). Do that, and you'll receive 60,000 EXP points, 1,500,000 Zens, and 1 Jewel of Chaos as a reward from the Shadow Phantom Soldier.

entries.english: I'm always up for hunting down monsters....

entries.english: I accept your quest. (Accept)

entries.english: I don't have the time. I'm sorry. (Refuse)

entries.english: That's unfortunate. You shouldn't pass up on this if you want fast growth.... Come see me again before you reach level 255 if you decide to accept the quest. (The quest has been cancelled.)

entries.english: The Shadow Phantom unit reported that the Watchers of Kundun are short of some important supplies. I'm giving a quest with a handsome reward to those who bring me the supply for the Watchers. Are you interested? (Level 260-289)
entries.zh-CN: 幻影部队报告，昆顿监视者缺少一些重要物资。我准备给带来补给的人一项奖励丰厚的任务。你有兴趣吗？（等级260-289）

entries.english: What kind of supplies...?
entries.zh-CN: 什么物资……？

entries.english: Ok, I'll try it. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 好，我试试。（接受）

entries.english: It's the quartermaster unit's job. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 这是军需部队的工作。（拒绝）

entries.english: That's unfortunate. The reward for this mission is quite big... If you change your mind, please come back before you reach level 290. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 真可惜，这个任务奖励很丰厚。改变主意的话，请在达到290级前回来。（任务已取消。）

entries.english: A wise decision. Watchers of Kundun say that they need the 'Lost Map' to enter the barrier of Kundun but it's getting harder to get the map. Please bring me 3 pages of 'Lost Map Lv. 3' and I will give you a quest with a handsome reward.
entries.zh-CN: 明智的决定。昆顿监视者需要“失落的地图”才能进入昆顿的结界，但地图越来越难获得。请带来3页“失落的地图等级3”，我会交给你一项奖励丰厚的任务。

entries.english: Hold on, I will find a quest suitable for you. Wait a moment please. (Level 260-289)
entries.zh-CN: 稍等，我来找一个适合你的任务。请等一下。（等级260-289）

entries.english: Oh, already gone...
entries.zh-CN: 哦，已经没了……

entries.english: All right. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 好的。（接受）

entries.english: I'm busy now. I'll come back later. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 我现在很忙，稍后再来。（拒绝）

entries.english: That's unfortunate. It wouldn't take much time ... If you change your mind, please come back before you reach level 290. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 真可惜，本来不会花太多时间。改变主意的话，请在达到290级前回来。（任务已取消。）

entries.english: Recently the Shadow Phantom unit in Tarkan Desert is frequently attacked by the Iron Wheels. Go to Tarkan and kill 30 Iron Wheels. I will reward you when you come back and report me.
entries.zh-CN: 死亡沙漠的幻影部队最近频遭铁轮战士袭击。前往死亡沙漠，消灭30只铁轮战士，回来报告后领取奖励。

entries.english: Recent report from the Shadow Phantom unit in Tarkan Desert has it that Mutants and Tantaloses are creating mayhem there. Go to Tarkan and kill 20 Mutants and 20 Tataloses. I will reward you when you come back and report me.
entries.zh-CN: 死亡沙漠的幻影部队报告，破坏骑士和铁脊怪正在那里肆虐。前往死亡沙漠，消灭20只破坏骑士和20只铁脊怪，回来报告后领取奖励。

entries.english: Recently the Shadow Phantom unit in Tarkan Desert is frequently attacked by Mutants and Beam Knights. Go to Tarkan and kill 20 Mutants and 10 Beam Knights. I will reward you when you come back and report me.
entries.zh-CN: 死亡沙漠的幻影部队最近频遭破坏骑士和黑炎魔袭击。前往死亡沙漠，消灭20只破坏骑士和10只黑炎魔，回来报告后领取奖励。

entries.english: Oh, this is a request from the Shadow Phantom unit in Tarkan Desert asking for help repelling Mutants and finding the training material for recruits. Go to Tarkan, kill 20 Mutants and find 1 Staff of Resurrection (Wizardry damage +12). I will reward you when you bring me the staff.
entries.zh-CN: 死亡沙漠的幻影部队请求击退破坏骑士，并收集新兵训练用品。前往死亡沙漠，消灭20只破坏骑士，找到1把复活之杖（魔法攻击力+12）。带回法杖后领取奖励。

entries.english: Oh, this is a request from the Shadow Phantom unit in Tarkan Desert asking for help repelling Mutants and finding the training material for recruits. Go to Tarkan, kill 20 Mutants and find 10 Unirias. I will reward you when you bring me the Unirias.

entries.english: The Shadow Phantom unit in Icarus, gateway to the Castle in Heaven is in trouble since Alquamoses and Alpha Crusts have blocked their supply route. Go to Icarus and kill 20 Alquamoses and 10 Alpha Crusts. I will reward you when you come back and report me.

entries.zh-CN: 前往坎特鲁遗址，消灭20只裂角狼，再带1把远古之杖（魔法攻击力+12）找幻影导师领取奖励。

entries.zh-CN: 昆顿监视者（1）

entries.zh-CN: 幻影部队的委托（1）

entries.english: Welcome to the newly founded Devias branch of the mercenary guild. We're the one who stopped Kundun's Army along with the 5 major clans but now most of the veterans have retired. So we decided to adopt the Free Mercenary system as we open this guild office.
entries.zh-CN: 欢迎来到新成立的佣兵公会冰风谷分部。我们曾与5大家族一同阻挡昆顿军团，如今大部分老兵已经退役。因此，设立这个分部时，我们决定采用自由佣兵制度。

entries.english: What is the free mercenary?
entries.zh-CN: 什么是自由佣兵？

entries.english: Free mercenary doesn't really belong to the mercenary guild; anybody can receive a request and get the reward only if he or she has certain sum of money for registration. We take the deposit for each request, but it's fully refundable as you finish the request. Don't you worry. We request you what you can handle.
entries.zh-CN: 自由佣兵并不正式隶属公会;只需缴纳注册费，任何人都能接取委托并获得奖励。每项委托另收押金，完成后全额退还。放心，我们会分配你能胜任的任务。

entries.english: How much is the registration fee and the deposit?
entries.zh-CN: 注册费和押金各是多少？

entries.english: 1 million Zen for free mercenary registration and 500,000 Zen for deposit. Will you register as a free mercenary now? (Lv. 350 - Master Level)
entries.zh-CN: 自由佣兵注册费为1百万金币，押金为500,000金币。现在要注册吗？（等级350至大师等级）

entries.english: Hmm, free mercenary����
entries.zh-CN: 嗯，自由佣兵……

entries.english: I will sign up. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 我要注册。（接受）

entries.english: No, I don't want to. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 不，我不想注册。（拒绝）

entries.english: That's unfortunate, the reward is quite awesome. Please come back if you change your mind. (Free mercenary registration has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 真可惜，奖励很丰厚。改变主意的话请再来。（自由佣兵注册已取消。）

entries.english: A wise decision. Give me 1 million Zen and I will sign you up right away.
entries.zh-CN: 明智的决定。交给我1百万金币，我马上为你注册。

entries.english: Put 500,000 Zen as deposit and I will offer you a Letter of Request came to the mercenary guild. Each request has its level and difficulty. Right click on the Letter of Request to check the information. Please note that you need to press (T) and click 'Start Quest' button at the bottom to check the information again once you close the information window. Do you want to take a Letter of Request? (Lv. 350 - 400)
entries.zh-CN: 缴纳500,000金币押金后，可领取公会委托书。各委托等级和难度不同，右键点击委托书可查看详情。关闭窗口后，按（T）并点击底部“开始任务”可再次查看。要领取委托书吗？（等级350-400）

entries.english: Hmm, Letter of Request����
entries.zh-CN: 嗯，委托书……

entries.english: Ok, I'll give it a try. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 好，我试试。（接受）

entries.english: I don't have time right now. I'll come back later. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 我现在没时间，稍后再来。（拒绝）

entries.english: That's unfortunate, please come back later when you have time. (Failed to receive the Letter of Request.)
entries.zh-CN: 真可惜，有空再来吧。（未领取委托书。）

entries.english: Here is the Letter of Request for you. Right click on the letter to check the information. Please note that you cannot receive refund of 500,000 Zen deposit if you give up the quest. You also need to bring the 'Request Completion Certificate' to get the refund. Once again, you need to press (T) and click 'Start Quest' button at the bottom to check the information again once you close the information window. Good bye, then.
entries.zh-CN: 这是你的委托书，右键点击可查看详情。放弃任务将无法取回500,000金币押金。完成后须携带“委托完成证明”办理退款。关闭详情窗口后，按（T）并点击底部“开始任务”可再次查看。再见。

entries.english: Mercenary's request varies depending on the day of the week. Please check the location and task before you start. (Lv. 350 - 400)
entries.zh-CN: 佣兵委托每天不同，出发前请确认地点和任务。（等级350-400）

entries.english: Oh, there are different requests depending on the day of the week.
entries.zh-CN: 原来一周中每天的委托都不同。

entries.english: Check the request information. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 查看委托详情。（接受）

entries.english: Request from Kalima; Location: Kalima 6; Task: Talk to Priestess Beina in the Underwater Temple; Reward: Random, Red Box; Note: Drop Lost Map +6 on the ground to enter Kalima
entries.zh-CN: 卡利玛的委托;地点：卡利玛6;任务：与水下神殿的女祭司Beina交谈;奖励：随机奖励、红色箱子;提示：将失落的地图+6丢在地上可进入卡利玛。

entries.english: Hi, I'm Priestess Beina, protector of this Underwater Temple. This temple is Kundun's first target since Etramu keeps his body in the sealed stone. We're always short of fighters so I request help to the mercenary guild. Would you check the request? (Lv. 350 - 400)
entries.zh-CN: 你好，我是水下神殿的守护者、女祭司Beina。Etramu的身体就在封印石中，因此这里是昆顿的首要目标。我们一直缺少战士，只能向佣兵公会求援。要查看委托吗？（等级350-400）

entries.english: The objective should be defending this place, then.
entries.zh-CN: 目标应该就是守护这里吧。

entries.english: Yes, please. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 好的，请说。（接受）

entries.english: I'm not ready yet. Please wait. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 我还没准备好，请等一下。（拒绝）

entries.english: I'll give you a full briefing when you're ready, then. May the grace of God be with you�� (The quest has been cancelled)
entries.zh-CN: 准备好后，我再详细说明。愿神庇佑你……（任务已取消）

entries.english: First you need to eliminate Kundun's combatants who attack the temple entrance and then get rid of the enemies who cast spell on the sealed stone. I'll give you the 2nd goal when you finish 1st goal and come back to me. Here's the 1st goal; go to Kalima 6 and eliminate 30 Aegis and 20 Rogue Centurions, Kundun's combatants. (Party Possible)
entries.zh-CN: 先清除攻击神殿入口的敌兵，再对付向封印石施法的敌人。第2项目标会在完成第1项并返回后交代。第1项目标;前往卡利玛6，消灭30只Aegis和20只Rogue Centurion。（可组队）

entries.english: Good job. You made it easier for us to protect the temple entrance. The 2nd goal is to punish the enemies attacking the sealed stone. Etramu saved the empire by changing his body into a sealed stone, but his soul is getting engulfed with madness. Do you want to proceed? (Lv. 350 - 400)
entries.zh-CN: 做得好，神殿入口现在容易守住了。第2项目标是惩治攻击封印石的敌人。Etramu化身封印石拯救帝国，灵魂却逐渐被疯狂吞噬。要继续吗？（等级350-400）

entries.english: It's easier than anticipated.
entries.zh-CN: 比想象中容易。

entries.english: Yes, right away. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 好，我马上去。（接受）

entries.english: I'm not ready yet. Please wait. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 我还没准备好，请等一下。（拒绝）

entries.english: I'll give you a full briefing when you're ready, then. May the grace of God be with you�� (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 准备好后，我再详细说明。愿神庇佑你……（任务已取消。）

entries.english: The last ones to deal with are Bloody Soldiers and Death Angels casting spell on the sealed stone. Kill 30 Bloody Soldiers and 20 Death Angels and come back to me to get reward. (Party Possible)
entries.zh-CN: 最后要对付的是向封印石施法的Bloody Soldier和Death Angel。消灭30只Bloody Soldier和20只Death Angel后，回来领取奖励。（可组队）

entries.english: Request from Merchant Zyro; Location: in every town; Task: Talk to General Goods Merchant Zyro; Reward: Random, Green Box; Note: General Goods Merchant Zyro goes round Noria, Elveland, Lorencia and Devias and sell things.
entries.zh-CN: 商人Zyro的委托;地点：各城镇;任务：与杂货商人Zyro交谈;奖励：随机奖励、绿色箱子;提示：Zyro往返于仙踪林、幻术园、勇者大陆和冰风谷售货。

entries.english: What can I help you? Ah�� you're the one from the mercenary guild! Speaking frankly, I would never have requested the mercenary guild if I had had any other option�� Well, never mind. There are 2 requests, first is to collect the Stardust powder and secondly, obtaining a rare jewel. Will you accept? (Lv. 350 - 400)
entries.zh-CN: 有什么事？啊，你是佣兵公会派来的！坦白说，若有别的办法，我绝不会求助公会……算了。共有2项委托：先收集星尘粉末，再寻找稀有宝石。愿意接受吗？（等级350-400）

entries.english: ���� He seems to be a miser����
entries.zh-CN: ……他似乎是个吝啬鬼……

entries.english: Yes, I'll take it. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 好，我接受。（接受）

entries.english: I don't feel like doing it. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 我不想做。（拒绝）

entries.english: Better grab a chance than to regret it. Well, come back later if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 抓住机会，总比事后后悔好。改变主意再来吧。（任务已取消。）

entries.english: First task is to collect the Stardust, which is the base material of the popular cosmetic product, Della. The ladies in a queue threaten me so I had to ask the mercenary guild. You can extract a small amount of Stardust from Queen Rainiers in the Icarus. Please bring me 20 units of Stardust. (Party Possible)
entries.zh-CN: 先收集星尘，它是热门化妆品Della的原料。排队等货的女士们威胁我，我才不得不求助公会。天空之城的风后身上能提取少量星尘。请带来20份星尘。（可组队）

entries.english: Thank you. You saved me from the execution ground. Second task is to get me the rare jewel Witch Queens in Aida carry on them. It's so beautiful as to captivate Witch Queens with such brilliance. Naturally, it's extremely expensive in the market. (Lv. 350 - 400)
entries.zh-CN: 谢谢，你救了我一命。接下来请找幽暗森林Witch Queen携带的稀有宝石。它光彩夺目，连Witch Queen都为之着迷，市场价格自然极高。（等级350-400）

entries.english: So you want me to take the With Queen's jewel.
entries.zh-CN: 你想让我夺取Witch Queen的宝石？

entries.english: Ok, I will head for Aida at once. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 好，我马上前往幽暗森林。（接受）

entries.english: Give me some time to prepare. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 给我些时间准备。（拒绝）

entries.english: Better grab a chance than to regret it. Well, come back later if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 抓住机会，总比事后后悔好。改变主意再来吧。（任务已取消。）

entries.english: Enter into Aida 2 and you will find Witch Queens. They always carry 'Kalt Stone' on themselves so eliminate them and take the jewel from them. Bring me 10 Kalt Stones. (Party Possible)
entries.zh-CN: 幽暗森林2有Witch Queen，它们随身携带“Kalt Stone”。消灭它们，取得宝石，请带回10颗Kalt Stone。（可组队）

entries.english: Request from the Gens Steward; Location: Gens Duprian- Lorencia, Gens Banert- Noria; Task: Talk to the Gens Steward; Reward: Random, Purple Box; Note: If you haven't joined the Gens yet, choose one and join now to proceed.
entries.zh-CN: 家族管家的委托;地点：Duprian家族在勇者大陆，Banert家族在仙踪林;任务：与家族管家交谈;奖励：随机奖励、紫色箱子;提示：尚未加入家族者须先选择并加入一个家族。

entries.english: How have you been? On behalf of the master of our clan, I thank you for answering the call of the clan. I personally hate to let the wandering mercenaries do this job, so I requested to send someone of the clan. I hope this didn't offend you. (Lv. 350 - 400)
entries.zh-CN: 近来可好？我代表族长感谢你响应家族的召唤。我不愿把此事交给流浪佣兵，所以要求派一位家族成员前来。希望你不要介意。（等级350-400）

entries.english: ���� Something pestering seems to happen����
entries.zh-CN: ……似乎有麻烦事……

entries.english: Not at all. It's only natural to work for the clan. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 不介意，为家族效力是应该的。（接受）

entries.english: You know well enough. I don't want to talk about it. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 你心里清楚，我不想谈。（拒绝）

entries.english: I didn't mean to pester you. But as the clan gets stronger, so do you. Please come back if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 我并非想烦扰你。家族越强大，你也会越强大。改变主意后请再来。（任务已取消。）

entries.english: Thank you. Recently things get in the way of the clan's business. Especially things in Vulcanus are the worst. We did some investigation and our people got killed by the assassins. Please go to Vulcanus and eliminate 20 Bloody Slayers and 10 Vicious Bloody Slayers.
entries.zh-CN: 谢谢。最近家族事务处处受阻，尤其是Vulcanus。调查人员遭刺客杀害。请前往Vulcanus，消灭20只Bloody Slayer和10只Vicious Bloody Slayer。

entries.english: May the glory be with you�� Good job. We found an evidence of the enemy clan from the investigation. We need to attack them in revenge immediately. Will you take this job? (Lv. 350 - 400)
entries.zh-CN: 愿荣耀与你同在。干得好！调查发现了敌对家族参与的证据，我们必须立即反击。你愿意接下任务吗？（等级350-400）

entries.english: ���� Hmm, for the clan����
entries.zh-CN: ……嗯，为了家族……

entries.english: All right, I'll take it. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 好，我接受。（接受）

entries.english: Give me some time to prepare. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 给我些时间准备。（拒绝）

entries.english: I didn't mean to pester you. But as the clan gets stronger, so do you. Please come back if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 我并非想烦扰你。家族越强大，你也会越强大。改变主意后请再来。（任务已取消。）

entries.english: Cutting down the enemy clan's force will be the best revenge. Teach them a lesson by eliminating 5 of them who infiltrated in Vulcanus. Kill the enemy clan member in Vulcanus and come back to me to get the reward. (Can proceed only in Vulcanus)
entries.zh-CN: 削弱敌对家族就是最好的报复。消灭5名潜入Vulcanus的敌对家族成员，给他们一个教训。完成后回来领取奖励。（仅可在Vulcanus进行）

entries.english: Request from Kalima; Location: Kalima 6; Task: Talk to Priestess Beina in the Underwater Temple; Reward: Random, Red Box; Note: Drop Lost Map +6 on the ground to enter Kalima
entries.zh-CN: 卡利玛的委托;地点：卡利玛6;任务：与水下神殿的女祭司Beina交谈;奖励：随机奖励、红色箱子;提示：将失落的地图+6丢在地上可进入卡利玛。

entries.english: Hi, I'm Priestess Beina, protector of this Underwater Temple. The sealed stone got stronger thanks to your effort, but Kundun's army is also getting stronger now. We investigated the sealed stone and found that Kundun's army absorbs its energy while Etramu's soul is taking a rest. Please help us and confine the energy of insanity within the sealed stone. (Lv. 350 - 400)
entries.zh-CN: 你好，我是水下神殿的守护者、女祭司Beina。多亏你，封印石更坚固了，但昆顿军团也在变强。调查发现，他们趁Etramu灵魂休眠时吸取封印石的能量。请帮我们将疯狂之力封在石内。（等级350-400）

entries.english: A hero is only human in the end, the energy of insanity��
entries.zh-CN: 英雄终究也是人，疯狂之力啊……

entries.english: I will help you. Tell me what to do. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 我来帮忙，告诉我该做什么。（接受）

entries.english: I'm not ready yet. Please wait. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 我还没准备好，请等一下。（拒绝）

entries.english: I'll give you a full briefing when you're ready, then. May the grace of God be with you�� (The quest has been cancelled)
entries.zh-CN: 准备好后，我再详细说明。愿神庇佑你……（任务已取消）

entries.english: According to our investigation, Necrons and Death Centurions absorb the energy of insanity while the sealed stone is taking rest. Please get rid of 30 Necrons and 20 Death Centurions to keep the energy of insanity from spreading. I'll prepare a reward when you finish this job. (Party Possible)
entries.zh-CN: 调查发现，Necron和Death Centurion趁封印石休眠时吸取疯狂之力。请消灭30只Necron和20只Death Centurion，阻止它扩散。完成后我会准备奖励。（可组队）

entries.english: Good job. The energy of insanity is safely contained since Necrons and Death Centurions have been eliminated. But the portion they already absorbed has been transferred to Kundun so we need to directly attack him. Can you help us? (Lv. 350 - 400)
entries.zh-CN: 干得好。Necron和Death Centurion被消灭后，疯狂之力已得到控制。但他们吸取的部分已传给昆顿，我们必须直接进攻他。你愿意帮忙吗？（等级350-400）

entries.english: Kundun�� He's a hard target��
entries.zh-CN: 昆顿……他可不好对付……

entries.english: Ok, I will take care of him right away. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 好，我马上去对付他。（接受）

entries.english: I'm not ready yet. Please wait. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 我还没准备好，请等一下。（拒绝）

entries.english: I'll give you a full briefing when you're ready, then. May the grace of God be with you�� (The quest has been cancelled)
entries.zh-CN: 准备好后，我再详细说明。愿神庇佑你……（任务已取消）

entries.english: Get rid of Kundun and 10 Schrikers, the guard soldiers in the innermost depth of Kalima 6 and come back to me to get reward. (Party Possible)
entries.zh-CN: 消灭昆顿和10只守卫Schriker，它们位于卡利玛6最深处。完成后回来领取奖励。（可组队）

entries.english: Request from Merchant Zyro; Region: can be found in every town; Mission: Talk to General Goods Merchant Zyro; Reward: Random, Green Box; Note: General Goods Merchant Zyro goes round Noria, Elveland, Lorencia and Devias and sell things.
entries.zh-CN: 商人Zyro的委托;区域：各城镇;任务：与杂货商人Zyro交谈;奖励：随机奖励、绿色箱子;提示：Zyro往返于仙踪林、幻术园、勇者大陆和冰风谷售货。

entries.english: Ah, you came at last. The task is to get me some equipment for the war supplies. There's no business more profitable than the war supplies delivery. It's not like the good old days, but enough for a stable income. Especially Tantalos's Armor and Burnt Murderer's Club are expensive ones. (Lv. 350 - 400)
entries.zh-CN: 啊，你终于来了。这次要收集军需装备。没有比供应军需更赚钱的生意，虽不如从前，收入仍很稳定。尤其是铁脊怪的铠甲和Burnt Murderer的棍棒，价格很高。（等级350-400）

entries.english: ����Both are fairly easy...
entries.zh-CN: ……这两样都不难……

entries.english: So I need to get those two items. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 也就是要找这两种物品。（接受）

entries.english: I don't feel like doing it. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 我不想做。（拒绝）

entries.english: Better grab a chance than to regret it. Well, come back later if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 抓住机会，总比事后后悔好。改变主意再来吧。（任务已取消。）

entries.english: Would you bring me Tantalos's Armor first? I will reward you fairly when you come back with 20 suits of armor from Tantalos in Tarkan 2.
entries.zh-CN: 先找铁脊怪的铠甲好吗？带回20件铠甲，来自死亡沙漠2的铁脊怪，我会给你合理报酬。

entries.english: Well done. Now please bring me the clubs of Burnt Murderers in Vulcanus. (Lv. 350 - 400)
entries.zh-CN: 做得好。现在请带来Vulcanus的Burnt Murderer所用的棍棒。（等级350-400）

entries.english: That's a piece of cake.
entries.zh-CN: 小事一桩。

entries.english: I'll head for Vulcanus immediately. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 我马上前往Vulcanus。（接受）

entries.english: Give me some time to prepare. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 给我些时间准备。（拒绝）

entries.english: Better grab a chance than to regret it. Well, come back later if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 抓住机会，总比事后后悔好。改变主意再来吧。（任务已取消。）

entries.english: 10 clubs from the Burnt Murderers in Vulcanus will do. Please remember that the 'Heroes' in the Burnt Murderers don't drop the item. Come back to me with 10 Burnt Murderer's Clubs to get the reward.
entries.zh-CN: 需要10根Vulcanus的Burnt Murderer棍棒。注意，其中的“英雄”不会掉落该物品。带回10根Burnt Murderer棍棒后领取奖励。

entries.english: Request from the Gens Steward; Location: Gens Duprian- Lorencia, Gens Banert- Noria; Task: Talk to the Gens Steward; Reward: Random, Purple Box; Note: If you haven't joined the Gens yet, choose one and join now to proceed.
entries.zh-CN: 家族管家的委托;地点：Duprian家族在勇者大陆，Banert家族在仙踪林;任务：与家族管家交谈;奖励：随机奖励、紫色箱子;提示：尚未加入家族者须先选择并加入一个家族。

entries.english: How have you been? On behalf of the master of our clan, I thank you for answering the call of the clan. I personally hate to let the wandering mercenaries do this job, so I requested to send someone of the clan. I hope this didn't offend you. (Lv. 350 - 400)
entries.zh-CN: 近来可好？我代表族长感谢你响应家族的召唤。我不愿把此事交给流浪佣兵，所以要求派一位家族成员前来。希望你不要介意。（等级350-400）

entries.english: ���� Something pestering seems to happen����
entries.zh-CN: ……似乎有麻烦事……

entries.english: Not at all. It's only natural to work for the clan. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 不介意，为家族效力是应该的。（接受）

entries.english: You know well enough. I don't want to talk about it. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 你心里清楚，我不想谈。（拒绝）

entries.english: I didn't mean to pester you. But as the clan gets stronger, so do you. Please come back if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 我并非想烦扰你。家族越强大，你也会越强大。改变主意后请再来。（任务已取消。）

entries.english: Thank you. Recently things get in the way of the clan's business. Especially things in Vulcanus are the worst. We did some investigation and our people got killed by the assassins. Please go to Vulcanus and eliminate 20 Bloody Slayers and 10 Vicious Bloody Slayers.
entries.zh-CN: 谢谢。最近家族事务处处受阻，尤其是Vulcanus。调查人员遭刺客杀害。请前往Vulcanus，消灭20只Bloody Slayer和10只Vicious Bloody Slayer。

entries.english: May the glory be with you�� Good job. It must be the enemy clan who's controlling these Hero monsters. We need to attack them in revenge immediately. Will you take this job? (Lv. 350 - 400)
entries.zh-CN: 愿荣耀与你同在。干得好！一定是敌对家族在操纵这些英雄怪物。我们必须立即反击。你愿意接下任务吗？（等级350-400）

entries.english: ���� Hmm, for the clan����
entries.zh-CN: ……嗯，为了家族……

entries.english: All right, I'll take it. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 好，我接受。（接受）

entries.english: Give me some time to prepare. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 给我些时间准备。（拒绝）

entries.english: As the clan gets stronger, so do you. Please come back if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 家族越强大，你也会越强大。改变主意后请再来。（任务已取消。）

entries.english: Cutting down the enemy clan's force will be the best revenge. Teach them a lesson by eliminating 5 of them who infiltrated in Vulcanus. Kill the enemy clan member in Vulcanus and come back to me to get the reward. (Can proceed only in Vulcanus)
entries.zh-CN: 削弱敌对家族就是最好的报复。消灭5名潜入Vulcanus的敌对家族成员，给他们一个教训。完成后回来领取奖励。（仅可在Vulcanus进行）

entries.english: Request from mercenary guild; Location: Devias mercenary guild; Task: Talk to Mercenary Guild Manager Tercia; Reward: Random, Red Box, Purple box; Note: The elders of the guild are real old fossils..
entries.zh-CN: 佣兵公会的委托;地点：冰风谷佣兵公会;任务：与公会管理员Tercia交谈;奖励：随机奖励、红色箱子、紫色箱子;提示：公会长老真是些老古董……

entries.english: What can I help you? Ah�� you came for the request from us. Do you know Gaion? He was actually the sworn brother of the first mercenary guild master but our elders want to get rid of him since he's sort of an icon of treason. I don't understand their concern because he can never leave Varka. (Lv. 350 - 400)
entries.zh-CN: 有什么事？啊，你是来接委托的。你知道Gaion吗？他是首任会长的结义兄弟，但长老们认为他象征叛乱，想除掉他。他永远无法离开Varka，我不懂他们为何担心。（等级350-400）

entries.english: ������... What's behind this story?
entries.zh-CN: ……背后有什么故事？

entries.english: I want to hear more. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 我想听听详情。（接受）

entries.english: I don't know how this story can help me. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 我不知道听这些有什么用。（拒绝）

entries.english: Well, you may not want to learn more about him, but a mission is still a mission. I'll tell you more if you come back. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 你也许不想了解他，但任务终究是任务。再来时我会详细说明。（任务已取消。）

entries.english: Dural, the first master of the guild was a legendary commander who led us to a great victory against Kundun's army. He had to seclude himself from the world since Gaion's rebellion and the order of exterminating 5 major clans. The newly formed mercenary guild severed whatever relations with Gaion, but 5 major clans still want the mercenary guild to get rid of Gaion.
entries.zh-CN: 首任会长Dural是率领我们战胜昆顿军团的传奇统帅。Gaion叛乱及剿灭5大家族的命令，使他被迫隐退。新公会已与Gaion断绝关系，但5大家族仍要求公会除掉他。

entries.english: ���� That's what happened.
entries.zh-CN: ……原来如此。

entries.english: It wouldn't be easy to attack Gaion hiding in Varka. You'd better eliminate Raymond and Erkanne first to weaken his power. Without these two Gaion will not be as invincible. Go to Varka, kill Raymond and Erkanne and come back to me to get the reward from the guild.
entries.zh-CN: 进攻藏在Varka的Gaion并不容易。最好先除掉Raymond和Erkanne，削弱他的实力。少了这两人，Gaion便不再无懈可击。前往Varka消灭Raymond和Erkanne，然后回来领取公会奖励。

entries.english: Welcome back. Now all you need to do is eliminating Gaion in Varka. Are you ready? (Lv. 350 - 400)
entries.zh-CN: 欢迎回来。现在只需消灭Varka的Gaion。准备好了吗？（等级350-400）

entries.english: Ok, I'm ready. (Accept)
entries.zh-CN: 好，我准备好了。（接受）

entries.english: Give me some time to prepare. (Refuse)
entries.zh-CN: 给我些时间准备。（拒绝）

entries.english: Come back when you're ready and I'll give you a full briefing then. (The quest has been cancelled.)
entries.zh-CN: 准备好后再来，我会详细说明。（任务已取消。）

entries.english: Go to Varka and eliminate Advisor Jerind and Gaion Kharein. When you finish the job and come back to me, I'll give you the reward from the guild. Also, you can get the refund without the Lv. 1 Request Completion Certificate when you complete this task.
entries.zh-CN: 前往Varka，消灭Advisor Jerind和Gaion Kharein。完成后回来领取公会奖励。此外，完成此任务后，即使没有等级1委托完成证明，也能退还押金。

entries.english: Have you cleared today's request? Show me Lv. 1 Request Completion Certificate then.
entries.zh-CN: 完成今天的委托了吗？请出示等级1委托完成证明。

entries.english: Here it is.
entries.zh-CN: 在这里。

entries.english: Today's request is closed. Come back same time tomorrow and I will give you a new request. Thank you.
entries.zh-CN: 今天的委托结束了。明天同一时间再来，我会给你新委托。谢谢。

entries.english: New request for you hasn't been delivered yet. You can start a new request after 24 hours since a request has been cleared. Please come back after that.
entries.zh-CN: 新委托尚未送达。完成委托24小时后，才能开始新委托，请届时再来。

entries.english: Request information invalid; Location: none; Task: none; Reward: none; Note: Go back to Mercenary Guild Manager Tercia in Devias.
entries.zh-CN: 委托信息无效;地点：无;任务：无;奖励：无;提示：请返回冰风谷，寻找佣兵公会管理员Tercia。

entries.english: Oh, I didn't recognize how strong you are and gave you a wrong request. Would you give me back the Lv. 1 Letter of Request?
entries.zh-CN: 我没看出你已如此强大，给错委托了。请把等级1委托书还给我，好吗？

entries.english: Here you go.
entries.zh-CN: 给你。

entries.english: I will inform you when a request of your level is delivered. Thank you.
entries.zh-CN: 有适合你等级的委托时，我会通知你。谢谢。

entries.english: The mercenary guild office has been newly founded in Devias. Please find the guild office manager Tercia.
entries.zh-CN: 佣兵公会在冰风谷新设了办事处。请寻找管理员Tercia。

entries.english: You can register to the mercenary guild as a free mercenary with 1 million Zen. Tercia gives the registered free mercenaries 1 mission per day.
entries.zh-CN: 缴纳1百万金币即可注册为自由佣兵。Tercia每天向注册佣兵提供1项任务。

entries.english: Find the guild office manager Tercia and pay 500,000 Zen as a deposit to receive Lv. 1 Letter of Request which contains the quest of the day.
entries.zh-CN: 找到公会管理员Tercia，缴纳500,000金币押金，领取包含当天任务的等级1委托书。

entries.english: Find Priestess Beina of the Underwater Temple in Kalima 6 and check the request information.
entries.zh-CN: 前往卡利玛6，找到水下神殿的女祭司Beina，查看委托信息。

entries.english: Talk to Priestess Beina of the Underwater Temple and check the details of her request to the mercenary guild.
entries.zh-CN: 与水下神殿的女祭司Beina交谈，了解她向佣兵公会提出的委托详情。

entries.english: Eliminate 30 Aegis and 20 Rogue Centurions and go back to Beina to get the reward.
entries.zh-CN: 消灭30只Aegis和20只Rogue Centurion，然后返回Beina处领取奖励。

entries.zh-CN: 寻找往返仙踪林、幻术园、勇者大陆和冰风谷售货的商人Zyro。
